name: Ted Cruz
subject: My leading opponent just announced this...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
My top opponent announced over a quarter-million dollars of ads in this race. We can’t let Democrats drown our campaign in a flood of advertising dollars. | I was expecting this, Peter.

But I didn’t expect it so early in this race.

My Democrat opponent has already spent a quarter of a million dollars in ad spends to paint himself as a “moderate” even though he’s in the bag for Chuck Schumer.

This comes on the heels of Allred announcing he has raised $15 million already in his bid to defeat me. That is a LOT of money.

Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight only gave Adam a 3% chance of defeating Boebert. They projected he’d lose by over 45,000 votes!

The American people deserve mail that is delivered on time, and the carriers who provide this service deserve better working conditions. |
#
Folks, I have not held back when it comes to calling on Postmaster General Louis DeJoy to improve the United States Postal Service. From delayed mail service to poor working conditions for mail carriers in Minnesota, I am deeply concerned about the state of the USPS under Louis DeJoy — and I’m calling on him to answer to these concerns. **[Please join me in demanding Louis DeJoy answer our concerns right away. The USPS is a vital lifeline for millions of Minnesotans — delivering medicine, Social Security checks, mail-in ballots, and important documents and packages. The mail carriers who provide this service are superheroes, and they deserve to be treated as such.
I’ve heard from USPS mail carriers in Bemidji and Rochester who feel like they are set up to fail.

body:
Trump and his enablers in Congress clearly don’t. | | | | |
#### [View email in browser](https://mailchi.mp/db1f288bb801/test-3bj3a7oq6q-385?e=b9b3f70fc1)
---
[](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=c3cd318993&e=b9b3f70fc1)
Hi Friend,
Donald Trump is a bully and a liar, and that puts him in some awful company.
Back in the 1950s, Senator Joseph McCarthy followed what we’d now call _the Trump playbook_ to insult, smear, and destroy his political enemies. For years, he launched reckless attack after reckless attack, and no one stood up to stop him.
**Until someone did — a lawyer named Joseph Welch.** When McCarthy started bullying one of Welch’s much younger colleagues, Welch had enough. And he ended McCarthy’s political career with a single question:

_Until this moment, Senator, I think I never really gauged your cruelty or your recklessness...**Have you no sense of decency?

**_ We all know about Donald Trump’s cruelty and recklessness — he shows them off constantly, like they’re something to be proud of. **But when the time comes to stand up and say “enough,” far-right MAGA congressmen like my opponent John Carter do the opposite.** They’re right there with Trump, throwing another tiki torch on the fire Trump’s setting to our institutions, norms, and values.

That’s not how my parents raised me. They taught me to stand up for my values — values like decency, but also honesty, integrity, humility, respect, and accountability. And I’ve taught the same thing to my sons. **Somewhere along the way, John Carter lost sight of those values.**
Where’s the honesty in lying that the 2020 election was stolen?

Where’s the integrity in voting to toss out those election results?

Where’s the humility in dismissing volumes of scientific evidence on climate change as a media hoax?

Where’s the respect in telling women they can’t make their own healthcare decisions?

Where’s the accountability in missing vote after vote after vote after vote, more than 100 times last session alone?
And above all — when John Carter has supported Trump through impeachments, an insurrection, indictments, and intimidation — one has to ask: _**Mr. Carter, have you no sense of decency?**_
**I’m running to replace John Carter because I have a sense of decency, and I know Texas voters do too.** Will you help me make decency great again?

[**Whatever you can contribute today will go a long way in helping me defeat Trump’s ally John Carter in November. With your support, we can stop the cruelty and recklessness that’s dominated Washington for much too long.**](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=62e12c24b6&e=b9b3f70fc1)
| [Donate now ›››](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=210eb958dd&e=b9b3f70fc1)
---
When history looks back at politicians like Donald Trump and John Carter, it won’t be kind. **Let’s make sure history also says we stood up and said “enough.”

** With gratitude,
Stuart WhitlowDemocrat for U.S. Congress, TX-31
|
---
[](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=7b8d41379e&e=b9b3f70fc1)
Stuart Whitlow is a lifelong Democrat and a fifth-generation resident of TX-31 running to unseat Trump’s ally in Congress, MAGA Republican John Carter.
As a lawyer, Stuart has more than 35 years experience representing folks like us and taking on those in power. Now, he’s running for Congress to stand up for ALL Texans against the extremism of the MAGA movement.
Stuart’s opponent has put Trump’s interests ahead of America’s interests, and it’s wrecked havoc on Capitol Hill and here at home. Stuart knows that TX-31 needs a Congress that works for all us, not just for Donald Trump.
“We take care of each other here in Texas, and we deserve leaders in Congress who can be trusted to do the same. That's why I'm ready to fight for our values in Congress and stand up for ALL Texans. I'm asking for your support in the Democratic Primary on March 5th — so together, we can make sure our Texas values live on.”
— Stuart Whitlow
_Democrat for U.S. Congress, TX-31_

clean_body: We all know I won't do that though. | Fellow Patriot, I am an Army Veteran and a current Member of Congress in the free state of Florida. The Left wants me to quit and give up my fight, but we all know I'd never do that. Before being elected, I spent 12 years in the U.S. Army, including working under the Joint Special Operations Command. I served in Afghanistan, where I worked as a bomb disposal expert clearing safe paths for my fellow soldiers pushing into Taliban territory. The last bomb I discovered was in September 2010. We had just acquired the location of a high-value target and were moving in under the cover of darkness when a bomb exploded beneath me, causing the loss of both my legs and my left index finger. I woke up several days later in Walter Reed Army Medical Center wondering what I was going to do next. I won't lie and tell you it was easy because it wasn't. I realized I needed to find a new battlefield to serve on. So from there, I learned to walk again, graduated from Harvard, and won my election to Congress as a Republican in Florida. Despite the metal legs, I 'm not all that different from you. We're both just people who love America. We both see what's going on in our country right now: open borders, soaring inflation, the indoctrination of our children -- and the list goes on. That's why I'm emailing you right now. You and I together can turn our country back around and restore it to its former glory. I truly believe that. I've seen what can happen when Americans band together. To be blunt, I'd be dead if my fellow soldiers hadn't run toward that explosion where I lost my legs. I relied on them in Afghanistan to save my life, and now I need to rely on you as we work together to defend liberty and freedom here at home. | Your support means more than you know. body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=5466%2E5257348%2EhDaIDL ]Adam Schiff for Senate

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em.yNAKTE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC90_20240222_PM4_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=5466%2E5257348%2EhDaIDL ]Bryan Cranston

Hello Californians,

I’m writing to you today as a lifelong Californian myself — born and
raised. When I was a young lad there was a United States Senator from
California, named Alan Cranston who served a couple decades. Sharing that
last name made me a little popular in my elementary school, but it also
spurred my interest in politics. Over the years, the ebb and flow of
political ideology was normal, and within reason, regardless of the party
affiliation. Unfortunately that‘s not the case today. And I imagine that
we share a deep concern about the future of our country.

Every so often a ‘champion’ rises to the occasion, someone with the
courage and intelligence to fight for what is right — not for what is
politically safe. And that person couldn’t be needed more than now. There
is a champion among us. A person who put himself up as a target to his
political opponents in order to stay true to his unwavering belief in our
constitution and the defense of our democracy.

I personally don’t like hearing people “tell me” who to vote for, so I
won’t do that to you either. I will simply say that I am exceedingly proud
to cast my vote for California’s next United States Senator for Adam
Schiff. I strongly feel that we need his fearless leadership in the
Senate. His clarion voice challenges the dangerous shift of policy within
the new Trumpian Republican Party. But Adam is eager to continue working
with the few remaining reasonable Republicans with respect and
determination to find the common ground that will greatly improve our
country. To do that we first need to get him into that position.

As we’ve all witnessed, Adam has been on the front lines, fighting for
justice, accountability, and a better future for all of us. He's shown us
time and time again that he's willing to break bad politics, and deliver
for California and the country, as only a true ‘champion’ can.

I am thoroughly convinced that we need Adam Schiff as our next US Senator
to fight for a better and brighter future. Thanks for your time, and I
wish you all well.

Bryan Cranston

subject: hard email to write

body:
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=20859%2E4449941%2EjZxzfo)

| _Our friend Harry Dunn is running for Congress in Maryland’s Third District.**_I hope you’ll read the message below from him and consider splitting a donation between Harry’s campaign and Fight for Reform._**_
---
[ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/38181?t=7&akid=20859%2E4449941%2EjZxzfo)
Hey there,

I'll be straight with you, I've done a lot of tough things in my life. I played college football, tried to make it in the NFL and CFL. That was tough, mentally, physically, emotionally.

I served as a Capitol police officer for over 15 years, those were tough some days.

But the aftermath of the January 6 insurrection was one of the toughest things I've been through. My pain, my trauma, it didn't end on January 7\.

Even after the violence of that day, I dealt with death threats. I dealt with people harassing me for speaking out. And when I decided to testify in front of Congress? It was one of the toughest things I've ever faced.

But I did testify, because it was my duty not just as an officer, but as an American. I made a big step the day I testified for the January 6 committee. I stepped in the direction of protecting our democracy.

_And, I've never looked back._
[**I'm ready to protect our democracy as a Congressman, and I need you to join me. I wouldn’t ask if this fight wasn’t absolutely critical – will you split a donation between Fight for Reform and my campaign? It's going to be tough, but like I said, I'm no stranger to tough.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/38181?t=8&akid=20859%2E4449941%2EjZxzfo)

name: Your America
subject: A bright light during dark hours
body:
C.S. Lewis was a war hero

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30612%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=s9iH9ionS%2b7G0uxd1Nf%2byQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News _because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--like our free online courses. _ _ And though we’re best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author--C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **“[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30613%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eKp1lo%2fHJgEB81kJPZzKaA&sysid=1)” **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30614%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=tdB3M7AdL3dTQLRzWl8klw&sysid=1),” **we’ve received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis’ writings. [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30625%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eauS2jBYzu8a%2bTqKTNnN5Q&sysid=1) We’ve also heard from many of our friends that they would love to own a DVD version. So, I’m pleased to announce that the C.S. Lewis course is available on DVD for your home library. You can also give it as a gift or use it in a small group, such as a Bible study or book club. We only made a few of these special sets, so get this premium edition of **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30614%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=tdB3M7AdL3dTQLRzWl8klw&sysid=1)”** on DVD today. Given how popular this course is, the DVD box set won’t last long. Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link, while they last: [**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/be-the-first-to-get-hillsdales-new-c-s-lewis-dvd-set/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30626%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=k8QmxJACBirQwMJEU1IP3A&sysid=1) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Vice President National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

name: Pro Life Update
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history,

This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zha924c6n2kn5dlcc6r27qf4384ved5d5bqebb7o_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sdge6p33clh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z41jak3cj0m7jlk2vo7euktmu4489ak030hiboa8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sdge6p33clh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zo2d0d6th22i2j5456dok8386958lac3uej7qh9g_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sdge6p33clh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

C.S. Lewis was a war hero

Thanks for opening my email. Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News_ because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—like our free online courses. __ And though we’re best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author—C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **“[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9q0c53mco55secr0nuspt007e9ui2eoueuvbh28_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sdge6o35c9h2bs)” **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9u4psi7ict4moeenpl0fs0etjcp5om3tsq3mr5g_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sdge6o35c9h2bs),” **we’ve received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis’ writings. So, I’m pleased to announce that the C.S. Lewis course is available on DVD for your home library. You can also give it as a gift or use it in a small group, such as a Bible study or book club. We only made a few of these special sets, so get this premium edition of **“[An Introduction to C.S. name: Andrew Piantidosi
subject: Elections, Your Ballot, & SCOTUS
body:
SCOTUS reviews case on Trump's 2024 ballot eligibility, sparked by a Colorado ruling and Maine's decision, amid debates on 14th Amendment and state powers.
| | | |
---
| |
---
| |
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| The US Supreme Court heard oral arguments in the case of "Trump v Anderson" earlier this month. That case will determine whether state officials may remove Donald Trump from the 2024 ballot. The case arose when Norma Anderson, a former Republican Colorado senator, and 5 other plaintiffs appealed a U. S. District court ruling that the 14th Amendment did not apply to the President. In a 4-3 decision, the Colorado Supreme Court overruled the lower court but stayed its decision pending SCOTUS review. Maine Secretary of State Shenna Bellows has also unilaterally ruled that Trump is ineligible to be on the Maine Ballot.

The Colorado decision, and by extension Bellow's decision, was deeply partisan and incredibly dangerous, as I have publicly stated on several news outlets these past weeks. Shenna Bellows action is equally dangerous and partisan.
Comments by Associate Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson and Elena Kagan appear to support the argument that the 14th amendment does not apply to a President and that allowing any state to unilaterally remove a presidential candidate from the ballot is a troubling idea. it seems almost a foregone conclusion that the Colorado decision will be reversed.
A unanimous and unambiguous decision would send a stern message to the country - the constitution is not partisan: It is the greatest framework for a Republic. It is our bedrock, and it must not be politicized - we can apply this message to a number of our long-standing institutions in a deeply divided nation.

Do you sometimes feel like you don’t recognize your country anymore... or that we’re living in an episode of the Twilight Zone?

Me too. My name is Eric Hovde, and I’m excited to announce that I am officially launching my campaign for Senate in Wisconsin.

# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _We Are Here to Help!_**
---
Friends, We hope to see many of you this weekend at our 2024 Congress of Counties! We are so excited to get together with our fellow Republicans to prepare for the elections ahead this year. While Congress of Counties is a great place to add tools to your toolbox, we wanted to remind you that it is **not your only opportunity to grow your party building skills!** Our staff at the IN GOP HQ have been traveling the state to meet with local parties and help them build from the grassroots up. From recruiting and messaging to county officer and data center training, we are always happy to hit the road and work with our county parties! Over the last few months alone, some of the trainings and meetings our team has attended and/or assisted in have included the 3rd district meetings, Monroe County grassroots training, White County data training, Clinton County precinct committeeman and state delegate training, Floyd County data trainings. We have also helped with or attended Marion County GOP meetings, the Bartholomew County GOP Women's Club meeting, and virtual trainings that included the 8th district and Hamilton County data training.
As you can see, we are willing to come to you! Our staff is ready and willing to engage with our grassroots in every corner of the state. Please do not hesitate to reach out and let us know if you have questions, want an update on state party happenings, or if your local party would like training in an area of need! Thank you for all that you do.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# Hoosier Republican Leaders Continue to Take Action on The Biden Border Crisis

---
---
| | The Biden border crisis continues to become a bigger issue for all states in the U.S., including Indiana. While Democrats sit on their hands, Hoosier Republicans have taken leadership on this issue. For example, earlier this month Gov. Holcomb announced that he would be sending the Indiana National Guard to assist Texas in defending the southern border, because Biden and the Democrats are actively working to keep our border wide open. In fact, right here in Indiana, cities run by Democrat mayors are refusing to enforce federal immigration laws! These are SANCTUARY CITIES, right here in our home state. This is a dangerous policy that gives protection and immunity to the over 9 million illegal border crossings that we have seen since Biden took office. However, once again, Republicans have stepped up to the plate. Republican leaders in the General Assembly are working on Senate Bill 181, which will allow the Indiana Attorney General to file a lawsuit to stop a city or college from enforcing a sanctuary city/campus policy. **SB 181: Enforcement of Sanctuary City/Campus Ban (Author: Sen. Koch) ** **Goal and contents of SB 181: **
* A sanctuary city is a municipality that limits or denies cooperation with federal immigration authorities in enforcing immigration laws.
* Indiana law already bans local governments from enacting "sanctuary city" policies, and bans public and private colleges from enacting "sanctuary campus" policies.
* However, the enforcement mechanism under our law was struck down by the courts on technical grounds. Without a way to enforce our existing law, at least 4 Indiana cities currently declare themselves sanctuary cities: Gary (ordinance), East Chicago (ordinance), West Lafayette (ordinance), and Marion County/Indianapolis (judicial settlement agreement).
* SB 181 fixes this issue so our law against sanctuary cities can be enforced. Under the bill, the Attorney General will file a lawsuit to stop a city or college from enforcing a sanctuary city/campus policy.

Bill status: Passed Senate, Currently on First Reading in the House. A few things to consider when wondering how the southern border impacts Indiana:
* **71%** of all Indiana overdose deaths from 2021-2022 were from synthetic opioids, like fentanyl, which are mainly manufactured outside of the U.S.
* Fentanyl is now the leading cause of death for Americans ages 18-45, with a **94%** increase in number of deaths by Fentanyl!

SB 181 aims to safeguard Hoosiers from the numerous challenges streaming across our southern border by allowing Indiana's AG to do one simple thing that Democrats refuse to do, ENFORCE THE LAW. Democrats would rather create safe zones for those who cross the border illegally.

America has returned to the moon for the first time since 1972 with the touchdown of Intuitive Machines' Odysseus lander Thursday afternoon, marking the first successful private moon mission.

# FRIDAY, FEBRUARY 23, 2024
---|---
**Good Morning**! On this date in 1896, the first tootsie roll was sold for a penny at a small Brooklyn store by inventor Leo Hirshfield. Every day, 65 million Tootsie Rolls roll out of a giant factory. ([See How They're Made](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FqwzAURb9G2mKen2TJGjQEiodCuqTQ0cjWU6wiR8FWbPL3xZ2z3ss5cH4u_cXFFO-3LzeTLSH3bixxox5PKE4oe8m9DURIgpOtNbTKGGiQTxacCaKRCJLagVrlRaj9AFqgbgVow6NFQAmIooZGSV3pAzBu1CSDMkRMAvlY8lL95ngvE4X0yhst1ZhnnuxUymNl4sywY9jt-1698rM8Bzr-Y3FlnJjoNiY-1s9v7-rrtTtnvlj_2GNKcVWaSbjNLqZ_ZXkb-BcAAP__5Q5QbQ)) Our lead story today is America's return to the moon with the successful landing of the Odysseus, built by a Texas company and launched by Elon Musk's SpaceX rocket -- a great win for the entrepreneurial spirit. In case you haven't signed up for _The Flyover_ yet, you can do that here [with one click](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQANCvgS0WPjDkBoZKkae6a0cLm8O-FpvIoan691XVMdnf9N6HcQiceV_ewka-pjKGufKdRjiBPoEZjYw-EQFpSb516mwRVQdy9RqmEG2cIqqIqAEngLYN1qWA3VmBZA8KjALQreqscY3DpDsMsyOTLBIJoyhyLUfzUXivK6X8U-50NHPZZPZrrdeb0C8CegH9IxHQD2Hh-ZX3zz-jexL6Eq_fnDPfrBNGLVvg_G_tV92EvhglD__cyPo04DcAAP__8p5bFg). ## U.S. Puts a Lander on the Moon
America has [returned to the moon](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHOpCAURp8Gu2uYK6IUFtvY_dtuaRAuygbB4J0x8_abmXrrL_lyzvnzs_zYmGLeftuDJg5lsY7jixYE7ADVoho_BSKkrqHpMchRGyN7bPZJahd0r4N9jKvx3vhu1cGtA5rRjaPyTZxQopKI3UP2Wg3tYELXG-sGUkEbIqEk-ciltn9LzLxTSO_yotq6cjRp2pnPS3S_BM4C5_u-20pPpnp9doEzk9tzSWV7C5yv0zoSOD8vyGTrBZaZjpMhxHoxHKVkSDb7mDfYbQrgKPOzvuGOvMNZ48syQS1rYfh-uWoDw8cAJAKiwLmpkz_vmFK89CCU3A4b0xeW_5vuXwAAAP__UCpyhA) for the first time since 1972 with the touchdown of Intuitive Machines' _Odysseus_ lander Thursday afternoon, marking the first successful private moon mission. The final touchdown grew tense after the main navigation system failed, and the ship had to use experimental NASA technology to land. The lander's communications signals were weak but still strong enough to confirm the landing. The mission was largely funded by $118 million paid to Intuitive Machines [by NASA to carry science equipment.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uwyAUQOGnwRsWXDAOA0Olyls6VepoEbjYtPxEhiby21ft3PksR9_Hdb3amGLZ3mxG00NdrevxgStQEBTkKgdvAiKgGNDwmV2U1myCYTeo0HHnL4oLvLmg9Y2DQhcmx0CBxyEaYCAZgOBsUnIeZx3EpK2bUQalEYlk6GOvx_hZY-k7hnTWBx6jq3lIZu_93oh4IbAQWOzNFXy2cau_mcDyjm4vNdXtJLBUf7aG343a3jHfe6PZfiHlrVNXc8bDRZtossXHstFcayGwtF6Pk4gleiJeOZul1Gpiw2H8_RlTik3NRLIt25j-lvq_QD8BAAD__86zaHA) A different company, Astrobotic Technology, attempted a moon mission last month, but it [failed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7ojWC4a4oHhNurz2SmuzLAknDBbmEt3fn3L1laNpRvNxXa-Ucir3_7SJ77GuxD09ZUWFWqFZzRh8FEHRo_jJwdkuC8w4PvxkdRTNzEDkNGlEtqwpuhDnxRkak0dAA4h6gtkad3JL1PNC7MREu4gMBiSkXtvps6bSHxLzd31KO3Hdxuwfve_HoP8NeBnwQnuR1_FWb2g9cZYBL1utRWUqIZW7OnZi4UaxqyZSujR1-2pFghJHNxFimNw0Wa2F6AzuBjM4MHA2Y_Nhf6Wc02HdYOC-Ucq_Hf3PKz8BAAD__6zSYwE) shortly after launch.
## Cell Phone Outage Hits Nationwide
[A nationwide disruption](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FurTAQRL_G7kDL2sa4cPEauvvalMgX1peNDEbgQJKvj0idZjTSSHN03h7DI3Di9fU_LORLzEMYC580YIWqQj1oOflIhKQk-cZC1zoHBuXsYzCNNU832YCkzYiggRRRB92za4yS7BFQA6JqwLTa1tZFZVwYLenYOiKhgSYuea_fM69lppi-8kl7PeZFJj-Xsh1C_RPYC-yv66rDJ-fjXgX297fAHvDud4RSqpN2_s5rNVJK25xXqvJHCS865O6n7eKU-Git0PBaAqdfTvnT-icAAP__vtpXZg) in cell phone service Thursday cut off tens of thousands of cell phone customers with AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon, US Cellular, and Consumer Cellular who were unable to place calls, send texts, or use the internet. The service problems began sometime [around 3:30 a.m. EST](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuszAURp8GNkeXi8F48PAv2fKvHZGNPyeuDI7IDVH79FU6dzw6y9H5uMwXn0verv_9Ciepzn6RfGBmxb1iPes2ugQw-hauMzSN1tLA7c0NOtFoQkyGDIUQRnQhpkQLTSmgozY7JtbE3Hc0jNqcjE39YP1ioNNogUYTYpa6nz5r3uSGVL7qgf201LUt7iZyfzT9v4bPDZ_9fcPr8VZv2CUvBQ2fF5TyLH5XXkQd2PN33ZSsNeQCVZ_ir1DEcYop2p46C2MxgBEDEGkC9EDt7uL9lUvJj9E0mq6rz-U3Qv5c8hMAAP__zJZjBw) and lasted throughout the day. More than 100,000 incidents were reported by customers, according to outage tracker _Downdectector_. AT&T customers appeared to be affected the worst. The company issued an apology and said it was in touch with the[ FBI and Department of Homeland Security](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2qpEAUhJ9GsxY9tn-BwU5gsDCbLRvKQav1LGrPtY8jvv3FiW9UBR98FPXv2T9ZFtmmP7yiVed7HlTe6MlQbsj2Nh5bBxDyGG1WpXXZNGlB8dyOqIsGQF3WZWbBtR1H4sEOzhUlKsTSUko2JcqztChtlVSNy4uGhwrWlQ0Q2RSjqN-T_142neGWy7-xJ4Nf46WdVV8hyn9F1EXUneeZrGG7WUQdNnOEiLoN5x2fPvsVC2-jCRiOXfQypyyLke2NoDKxwgx8BBjvDKtR4w_lCeacRWFmf6PA163i3Twemfz-uv7Gezu-bpGEsopsOq0sy2eh_vjXdwAAAP__Ye1vFw) to determine the cause of the outage.
## Google AI Overdoses on Diversity
Google suspended the imaging feature of its Gemini artificial intelligence tool after widespread criticism that it had been programmed to place diverse people of color into every image request. The final touchdown grew tense after the main navigation system failed, and the ship had to use experimental NASA technology to land. The lander's communications signals were weak but still strong enough to confirm the landing. The mission was largely funded by $118 million paid to Intuitive Machines A different company, Astrobotic Technology, attempted a moon mission last month, but it shortly after launch. Cell Phone Outage Hits Nationwide in cell phone service Thursday cut off tens of thousands of cell phone customers with AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon, US Cellular, and Consumer Cellular who were unable to place calls, send texts, or use the internet. The service problems began sometime and lasted throughout the day. More than 100,000 incidents were reported by customers, according to outage tracker Downdectector. AT&T customers appeared to be affected the worst. The company issued an apology and said it was in touch with the to determine the cause of the outage. Google AI Overdoses on Diversity Google suspended the imaging feature of its Gemini artificial intelligence tool after widespread criticism that it had been programmed to place diverse people of color into every image request. Google acknowledged that Gemini was "offering inaccuracies in some historical image generation depictions," and that it would work to solve those problem while pausing the image-generation function. body:
C.S. Lewis was a war hero

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=65c3ff7970c54eecb243464739a0ea01&_e=z9Yx-vZRNFu7zre6Cs_1a46GXnpzK158IaufX0Y0WljkOvg2DYrKL6XG-IA9ojf8A3gIHuwPu2DRHXg0eB2CXRV1z-U2J4OGTfjGX1Mt03hyY7lUpS9kgiNPgLSl5GHxF9PrsFw0zSMw2Tx5erbidDkmepeV-L-WnW4i_EmgRkHvKT75WbMd2BmWN7O677s_Zmz6OFa9O6oJ5Eu30DFaxK8GwS5pyrsfqquI7K1LYSEUJMPIJ15dCs13_2fNUPOuEjMv6qNaCBTi7YxRQFTKpZPCIbm7DSr1PMAYzElKpEfxTffGbGOB5fJfjkNEDouck7IFtcuFGgvrAvZcvByU5D3TR6Xm_v8zgkWTtLiUEggI8pA5SIEjcIiNAsoxzcaImHttxvwHpd0k-lt1erPSTeqTf-GAoRtincnNAPxPlaR1DR8FlQX7W6iujSjHyao9) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. Dear Peter,
Our nation stands at a critical juncture, where the very essence of democracy and free speech hangs in the balance.
Individuals like Daniel Ellsberg, John Kiriakou, Chelsea Manning, Edward Snowden, and Julian Assange have bravely exposed government corruption, shedding light on injustices that threaten the core principles of our society.
_But instead of honoring these truth-tellers, our government has chosen to persecute them._
As a staunch advocate for freedom of speech and transparency, I am reaching out to you today with an urgent plea: [join us in demanding the immediate release of Julian Assange.](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_2_23_24_em1rs_nd3&n=6)
Julian Assange, a journalist and publisher, has languished behind bars for 13 years for his role in uncovering the truth about governmental wrongdoings, from torture at Guantanamo Bay to anti-democratic actions by the DNC.
It's a travesty that exposing crimes has become a greater offense than the crimes themselves. [We cannot allow this injustice to continue.](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_2_23_24_em1rs_nd3&n=7)

_On my first day in office, I pledge to pardon Julian Assange and launch a thorough investigation into the corruption and crimes he has exposed._ Additionally, I will issue an executive order to put an end to any attempts by federal agencies to silence political speech.
But I cannot do this alone. I need your support.
[By signing our petition](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_2_23_24_em1rs_nd3&n=9), you'll join a chorus of voices demanding justice for Assange and protection for whistleblowers everywhere.
Together, we can ensure that the voices of truth are heard and that those who dare to speak out against injustice are not silenced.
_Please take a moment to add your name to our petition and share it with your friends, family, and colleagues._ Every signature brings us one step closer to securing Julian Assange's freedom and safeguarding our fundamental rights.
Thank you for your unwavering commitment to justice and liberty.

body:
why I'm fighting so hard to represent MI-10 | |
---
| | [ ](https://milwaukeedems.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e61dc0cbc36b6b9ece6e4cb38&id=48edb057cf&e=4d37f34e0f)
---
| | Hi, it's Emily Busch, the pro-safety Democrat running to represent Michigan's 10th District in Congress.

Before I ask you to [**support my people-powered campaign with a donation today**](https://milwaukeedems.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e61dc0cbc36b6b9ece6e4cb38&id=7ef3170c99&e=4d37f34e0f), I'd like to tell you some of my story.

I grew up in a tight-knit Midwestern family. My mom, a nurse, and my dad, a manufacturing representative, taught me the importance of hard work and community.

After earning my Bachelor's Degree from Indiana University, and a Master's from Michigan State University, I settled down in Oakland County because I thought it'd be a great place to start a family. 20 years later now, and I was right!
---
| [ ](https://milwaukeedems.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e61dc0cbc36b6b9ece6e4cb38&id=ac2843308c&e=4d37f34e0f)
---
| Everything was great – until I experienced a parent's worst nightmare. On November 30, 2021, a student at my son's school opened fire. While my son survived, four of his peers had been shot and killed.

Our community was devastated. As a mom, I was scared, but more than anything, I was angry.

I never thought our community could be hit with such a tragedy. Even worse, the very people we've trusted to tackle this issue in the face of our loss have still done nothing to address the gun violence epidemic happening across the country.

_**And I, for one, am tired of relying on their "thoughts and prayers" to keep us safe. **_

I'm ready to roll up my sleeves and fight for common-sense gun safety measures – a ban on military-style weapons, increased background checks, and more!

[**But my campaign needs your help to get my name and message to folks across the district. To support my pro-safety vision for the future, will you chip in $15, $35 or $50 today?**](https://milwaukeedems.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e61dc0cbc36b6b9ece6e4cb38&id=34c2ff7323&e=4d37f34e0f)
---
| [DONATE TODAY](https://milwaukeedems.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e61dc0cbc36b6b9ece6e4cb38&id=43f848ca96&e=4d37f34e0f "DONATE TODAY")
---
| Thank you,
Emily Busch
---
| | | Emily first learned the importance of community and helping others from her mom, a nurse, and dad, a manufacturing representative, while growing up in a tight-knit, middle-class Midwestern family.

The proud product of public schools, Emily worked hard in and out of the classroom, balancing her studies and interest in performing arts with an after-school job as a cashier at Ace Hardware. She went on to earn her B.A. in Biology from Indiana University and Masters from Michigan State University.

Now, Emily is running for Congress in Michigan’s 10th District to keep our kids safe, protect our rights, and lower costs for Michigan families.

Emily chose to move to Oakland County two decades ago because it was the place she wanted to raise her family – a place with friendly neighbors, good schools, and safe neighborhoods.

She and her husband, a retired firefighter and Marine, enjoy camping, fishing, and visiting national parks in their free time.

How we flip this district blue
Dr. Bob is more energized than ever to defeat Rep. Bergman. He's building off momentum from last cycle and going into election season with the grit and tenacity MI01 has always deserved.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
If you’ve saved your payment information with Act Blue Express, your donation will process immediately:
CONTRIBUTE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=express_lane_10]
CONTRIBUTE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=express_lane_25]
CONTRIBUTE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=50&refcode=express_lane_50]
Friend,
Flipping districts like ours to blue is a long-term effort. When Dr. Bob started his campaign in 2021, we knew it might span multiple election cycles, although we aimed for immediate success.
Creating a movement takes relentless effort and dedication from people like you and us. That’s why we’ve launched the 36 County Strategy, with extensive outreach across all counties.
This means not just photo ops and meetings but intensive ground efforts - calling and door-knocking, especially in rural areas, to spark genuine conversations.
Our goal is to win as many counties as possible but also to narrow the voting gap. This is essential for keeping Michigan blue and supporting our Senate and presidential candidates, especially through the rural heartland of Michigan.
Join us. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
This campaign is about all of us - our families, our friends, and our neighbors. While the concept is straightforward, the execution is complex and resource-intensive.
We have deepened our engagement, particularly with independent voters who may feel alienated from the political process.
Effective outreach means going directly to voters, holding genuine conversations at their doors and over the phone, discussing our shared values, and exploring ways to enhance life in Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula.
Our staff from Iron Mountain, Marquette and Sault Ste. Marie in the Upper Peninsula, to Arenac, Petoskey and Traverse City in Northern Michigan, works tirelessly to flip this district blue. With your help and support, our grassroots efforts will be successful.
Thank you.
Kevin

subject: We need your help to do BIG things in 2024!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the New Pennsylvania Project
body:
| | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a477e89a39c2/we-need-your-help-to-do-big-things-in-2024?e=95417d7e87)
---
|
---
|
---
Hello friends!
We hope this edition of the New Pennsylvania Project eBlast finds you well. Please take a few moments to check out all the important news you can use, upcoming events, and other resources as we head towards the April primary and November general elections.
|
---
# Are You Down With NPP?
[](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=81fcb2ec3c&e=95417d7e87)
We are just 255 days away from the 2024 General Election but there is much work to be done — and we can’t do it alone! New Pennsylvania Project is on a mission to register 60,000 voters from across the Commonwealth, with a focus on reaching those from underserved and underrepresented communities. We can’t do that, however, without your continued support. If you haven’t yet, please consider clicking the button below and investing just a few dollars in these efforts.
Every dollar helps us host more events, reach more people, and ultimately, register more voters ahead of this incredibly high-stakes election!
| [Invest in our Democracy](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=8c9b40b86c&e=95417d7e87)
---
|
---
# Courts Corner
[Pennsylvania’s high court sides with township over its ban of a backyard gun range](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=c9f0d1c0e1&e=95417d7e87)(Associated Press)
* A township ordinance that limits firing guns to indoor and outdoor shooting ranges and zoning that significantly restricts where the ranges can be located do not violate the Second Amendment, Pennsylvania’s Supreme Court ruled Wednesday.

[US appeals court to decide if Pennsylvania mail-in ballots with wrong date still count](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=1256a7451b&e=95417d7e87)(Associated Press)
* A federal appeals court must decide if Pennsylvania voters need to put accurate handwritten dates on the outside envelopes of their mail-in ballots for the votes to count, a dispute with implications for this year’s presidential contest.

[Pennsylvania Supreme Court rules that GOP subpoena for voter information cannot be enforced](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=e4c458246c&e=95417d7e87)(NBC News)
* The Pennsylvania Supreme Court on Wednesday ruled that Republicans' subpoena of voter information after the 2020 election was unenforceable, overturning a previous court ruling.

|
---
# Social of the Week
| | | | [](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=ca705ee839&e=95417d7e87)| [](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=3e0da2919e&e=95417d7e87)| [](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=d9d5ee257e&e=95417d7e87)
---|---|---
This is the final eBlast of Black History Month but there is still time to go back and check out all of our content via the above social media channels!
|
---
# News You Can Use
[Young Philly voters will be key in the next election. Here’s how to mobilize them.](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=0f83e9c84e&e=95417d7e87)(Philadelphia Inquirer)
* Only 26% of eligible 18-year-olds in the Philadelphia region have registered to vote. As the 2024 elections draw closer, we hear urgent calls to increase youth voter registration, as though that will suddenly create engaged, first-time voters. While this concern is well founded, there are few serious options for funding, programs, or policies that will make a long-term difference in youth voter participation.

[51,000 18-Year-Old Residents In Philly Area/Allegheny Remain Unregistered In An Election Year](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=955019aa19&e=95417d7e87)(The Civics Center)
* Anyone who cares about elections and youth political participation should take a careful look at registration rates for the youngest voters. Four million young people turn 18 every year in the US, but if they are not registered, they can’t turn out to vote.

[Bucks County GOP Issues Statement Repudiating Right For Bucks Leader’s Post Calling For Lynching Of Former President Obama](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=34ff2cc7f7&e=95417d7e87)(Bucks County Beacon)
* A post authored by Right for Bucks leader Andy Meehan on the social media platform formerly known as Twitter drew public scorn and violated the media giant’s policies on hateful references.

|
---
# Upcoming Events
[](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=5b11a0cde3&e=95417d7e87)
Join For Our Future Action Fund Pennsylvania and affiliated organization New PA Project Education Fund as they celebrate Black History Month with an impactful Lunch & Learn on Monday, February 26 from 12-1PM on Zoom.
Moderated by our own Kadida Kenner and For Our Future’s Ashley McBride, the event will feature a conversation between Lt. Gov. Austin Davis, Superior Court Judge Timika Lane, Pennsylvania State Senator Art Haywood, and Pennsylvania State Representative Jordan Harris. [Click here to register for the event.](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=0c771d8b2c&e=95417d7e87)
|
---
Thank you for taking the time to stay informed. We'll be back in two weeks with the latest edition. In solidarity,#TeamNPP
|
---

**Help us prepare for the upcoming primary and general elections in 2024!**

body:
We're using every extra day we can!

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=8bN0s8S48ukOuMaWzZXwkQhKlv5I-M7NyCRBIqr07WA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=donate_to_leap_forward&n=1)
---
Friday, February 23, 2024 | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/leap_forward_day_campaign?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=donate_to_leap_forward&n=2) Peter -- Join us on Thursday, February 29, 2024, for **Leap Forward** **Day**! At the Pennsylvania Forward Party, we plan to use this extra day to its fullest. **Donate $29** in honor of this quadrennial advent and help us organize for our **2024 elections**. We have a series of events planned for the day. Sign up below! **Leap Forward Day** We're hosting **in-person events** across the state, so come join us for **face-to-face discussions** about politics, the state of the nation, and Pennsylvania Forward's goals for 2024. **In honor of this day, we also hope to hit 100 new donors. **While we would appreciate **$29** donations in honor of the leap day, join us by giving **small donations of $5, $10, and $20 to help sustain our involvement in state elections.** Give on our website at this link: [](https://home.forwardparty.com/donate_pennsylvania?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=donate_to_leap_forward&n=3) ...and attend a local event here: **[](https://home.forwardparty.com/leap_forward_day_campaign?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=donate_to_leap_forward&n=4)** **Events Locked in for February 29th:**
* [Allegheny County- Dancing Gnome Brewery](https://home.forwardparty.com/leap_forward_at_dancing_gnome_brewery_with_the_allegheny_county_forward_party?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=donate_to_leap_forward&n=5)
* [Bucks County- Station Taphouse](https://home.forwardparty.com/bucks_county_20240229?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=donate_to_leap_forward&n=6)
* [Somerset County](https://home.forwardparty.com/leap_forward_at_uptown_works_with_the_somerset_county_forward_party_20240229?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=donate_to_leap_forward&n=7)

**Every contribution helps us fight for a better Pennsylvania. Gifts will impact our success in the following endeavors in 2024:**
* We will run Statewide Candidates who will help us achieve minor party status.
* We will run several State House Candidates in the hopes of winning enough to prevent either of the major parties from achieving a majority.
* We will build our volunteer base across the Commonwealth.
* We will identify & develop leaders at the Regional & county levels.

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Help teach more kids across America to love our nation
body:
You’ve probably noticed that children today aren’t getting the same kind of education that you and I received

|
---
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ef3649ff8eae40f6b144141d86c4953d&_e=s5gKb8xQOG3-12GxboXfFlS78V5blSzLR8OD8q2XMEmC3QkDPijGSlNoXYZotaMc2ud2AFobXQrBSepMIeO8G0xt6ap-7D47uAOaeo67U6-lHtAUAut6OlTSJDTYgmJRpjDOdZ4irGc_EkkUI6QMLdDVfowKu9hXr0GUrrYXhqAx04akzawkYUsqupQate48K-TNyYkqVV4wKnBGyem2fTXVIqKM3xX8rHHiOC-KI9HG83nRLQomk-WavXGD-3rnNFTJrLqVx-ak71gq0xdT8QFm-ojIZjMjSUoWj96U8RSaA0jXNgNu3r4Rat5NVq_RnkVGNIBjSO-q97EKKCifJTO17PQtL46JbaaAp8XBcEC7N1n95pBcfpyx9ApOtS95lZSImrGHjAXlydSbhd9Fqw%3D%3D)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

You've probably noticed that children today aren't getting the same kind of education that you and I received when we were growing up.

We used to be taught to love our nation, cherish our history, and respect our fellow Americans. But all of that has changed.

In today's classroom, children are taught that America is fundamentally racist, that our history is one of oppression, and that we should focus on our differences instead of what unites us.

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ef3649ff8eae40f6b144141d86c4953d&_e=s5gKb8xQOG3-12GxboXfFlS78V5blSzLR8OD8q2XMEmC3QkDPijGSlNoXYZotaMc2ud2AFobXQrBSepMIeO8G0xt6ap-7D47uAOaeo67U6-lHtAUAut6OlTSJDTYgmJRpjDOdZ4irGc_EkkUI6QMLdDVfowKu9hXr0GUrrYXhqAx04akzawkYUsqupQate48K-TNyYkqVV4wKnBGyem2fTXVIqKM3xX8rHHiOC-KI9HG83nRLQomk-WavXGD-3rnuXywsG5SznSPAXAJ4o-PbRRQ9ZE6Yn5Cw36PxSsRIZvjXCigzhhLsuTuA7TQmr6NScXBaD8y9-21vQh78n_cHQIR18uXplt4rc4HxoKAOZiNtnKTp1rMSQBF-S-BUNZA_WcGOVXhsyUljliKy6fCow%3D%3D)
__To make matters worse: the right of parents to choose how and where their kids receive their education remains out of reach for most American families.

And this is exactly why we created our Little Patriots program--to give parents, grandparents, teachers, and caregivers a free online resource they can use to teach children unbiased civics lessons, history, and American values, anywhere and anytime--[completely free of charge.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ef3649ff8eae40f6b144141d86c4953d&_e=s5gKb8xQOG3-12GxboXfFlS78V5blSzLR8OD8q2XMEmC3QkDPijGSlNoXYZotaMc2ud2AFobXQrBSepMIeO8G0xt6ap-7D47uAOaeo67U6-lHtAUAut6OlTSJDTYgmJRpjDOdZ4irGc_EkkUI6QMLdDVfowKu9hXr0GUrrYXhqAx04akzawkYUsqupQate48K-TNyYkqVV4wKnBGyem2fTXVIqKM3xX8rHHiOC-KI9HG83nRLQomk-WavXGD-3rnPn7XV1orQj__TYSQU5N22p8lRVzd0RDBRaWm9gsw8E9l674Zto63aYifPpD5XmjcAgM5VqdaNTeCVh_56bdy4JcHjw5qmTy0gow96VLS1jFbBDo_Mb2WgxuuHWZULZYW4BsumZXT0fFqaBBZmeqpSA%3D%3D)

**And now we plan to do even more.**

To meet the growing demand for educational resources that teach children to love their country and its history, we're taking Little Patriots on the road to bring these educational resources to schools, churches, and community organizations!

But to help us fund this coast-to-coast effort, I need your help today.

We depend on the generous support of patriots like you to help us fund this program and share it with children and families across our great nation.

Hi Peter,

This week, Alabama’s Supreme Court ruled that “Frozen embryos are children, and those who destroy them **_can be held liable for wrongful death.”_**

**This ruling could set a dangerous precedent nationally, leading to other states attempting to define embryos as people.** In fact, a religious group is already using the Alabama ruling as a precedent in a Florida abortion rights case.

[**There are so many absurd and dangerous laws being passed – especially in red states. We believe that bringing more pro-choice women’s voices into these conversations will make a difference. Help us make this happen by rushing $20.24 or more today →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79572847/456876529/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_240223IVF_N_AU_90DO_9_G_TestB_L1&amount=20.24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkyMDA5YWU3LTYzZDItZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fHSnWv7dEpfhjRP5Z_QbOK5XsuPQMuROcEtBVYazjIM=)

Alabama’s new law will diminish the standard of care afforded to women struggling with infertility – it will be nearly impossible for IVF clinics to operate under these conditions.

According to CNN, “[Critics warn] it could send liability costs skyrocketing, making fertility treatment prices prohibitive for many families; it could discourage medical providers from performing infertility treatments in fear of being held liable each time an embryo does not turn into a successful pregnancy; and it could mean parents will now be forced to pay for lifelong storage fees of embryos they will never be allowed to discard, even if they don’t want any more children.”

The bill is now in the Joint Ways and Means Committee. **[We need your support to let the members of Ways and Means know how important this bill is and to urge them to vote yes to fully fund this program!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79573417/456878423/-826092230?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM3Y2UwMDk1LTY0ZDItZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=USouXe8ZB-Si2chyOIaPIdpLox-kep_hgWQj1p6YZfM=&emci=b78e5713-3ed0-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=c7ce0095-64d2-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=2107230)**

Oregon’s Marine Reserves are both living laboratories and underwater state parks that protect almost 10% of our state waters for biodiversity. It’s an essential program for managing and protecting our ocean habitat––but it needs adequate funding and resources to carry out its mission. In 2022 Oregon State University conducted a 10-year review of the Marine Reserves Program and recommended increased investment in the program including:
* More robust long-term ecological and socio-economic monitoring
* Better engagement with coastal communities (including Tribes)
* Develop strategies to enhance ecological resilience to climate change stressors

**[Will you lend your voice to help better protect our marine waters by asking lawmakers in the powerful Joint Ways and Means Committee to fully fund Oregon’s Marine Reserves?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79573421/456878426/-826092230?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM3Y2UwMDk1LTY0ZDItZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=USouXe8ZB-Si2chyOIaPIdpLox-kep_hgWQj1p6YZfM=&emci=b78e5713-3ed0-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=c7ce0095-64d2-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=2107230)** The Marine Reserves Bill essentially moves forward the OSU science-based recommendations. For a relatively small fiscal request ($1.1 million per biennium) the Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife Marine Reserves Program will be fully supported and help keep Oregon’s ocean healthy for years to come. Thank you for advocating to support HB 4132 A to fund Oregon’s Marine Reserves Program! Thank you,

Julia DeGraw
Coalition Director, OLCV | |

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: It’s official, I have a well-funded opponent running against me for Senate.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
John Deaton, a well-funded Republican, has launched a campaign to run against me for Senate in Massachusetts.
#
It’s official: John Deaton, a well-funded Republican, has launched a campaign to run against me for Senate in Massachusetts.
Apparently, the MAGA Republican machine couldn’t find a single Republican in Massachusetts to run against me — so they brought in someone from Rhode Island who will have the backing of the GOP and special interest groups.
This much is clear: We’re up against national Republicans who are desperate to take back the Senate and pass Trump’s agenda. We’re up against their rich buddies who are trying to stop us from taxing the wealthy, regulating big banks, and making our government work for working people.
[**It’s going to take a strong grassroots movement to compete and win. Can you please split a donation of $5 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Mandela Barnes’ work at The Long Run? We need to respond to my opponent’s campaign launch with the strongest amount of grassroots donations to protect our Senate majority.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.-45zWj&refcode=em240223-1-t12&t=1&akid=5221%2E196590%2EPvSZQa)
_If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Express Donate: $5](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1271?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.JFik5O&amount=5&refcode=em240223-1-t12&t=20&akid=5221%2E196590%2EPvSZQa)
[Express Donate: $25](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1273?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.VYOQM7&refcode=em240223-1-t12&t=21&akid=5221%2E196590%2EPvSZQa)
[Express Donate: $50](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1274?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.0cBriM&refcode=em240223-1-t12&t=22&akid=5221%2E196590%2EPvSZQa)
[Express Donate: $100](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1275?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.OdpQDA&refcode=em240223-1-t12&t=23&akid=5221%2E196590%2EPvSZQa)
[Express Donate: $250](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1266?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.o8D-wy&refcode=em240223-1-t12&t=24&akid=5221%2E196590%2EPvSZQa)
[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.-45zWj&refcode=em240223-1-t12&t=25&akid=5221%2E196590%2EPvSZQa)
I’m proud of the progress we’ve accomplished for Massachusetts families so far — like lowering the cost of hearing aids, passing a new tax on massive corporations that were paying $0 in taxes, getting student loan debt canceled, securing billions in funding for projects like an electric bus fleet and infrastructure repairs, and so much more.
But there’s plenty more to do for working people in Massachusetts and across the country. We’ve got to bring down the cost of housing. Put child care within reach for all working parents. Protect our Commonwealth from the climate crisis. Take power away from powerful interests like Big Pharma, Big Oil, and big banks and put it in the hands of working people — which means we need to root corruption out of Washington. And I’ve got the most sweeping set of anti-corruption plans since Watergate.
**This election is about who our government works for — and it’s about defending our democracy and our basic freedoms. I’m fighting to keep our Senate majority because if Republicans win any more power, they’ll restrict abortion access _everywhere_ , even in blue states that have passed abortion protections — like Massachusetts. They’ll threaten voting rights, LGBTQIA+ rights, Social Security, Medicare, and the Affordable Care Act — they’ll reward the rich and powerful, and embolden an extremist base across the country.
So I’m staying in this fight to stop MAGA extremism, to continue standing up to powerful special interests, and make real change for working people. Are you with me?
[**Please respond to my opponent’s announcement today with a donation of $5 or anything you can to support this campaign and Mandela Barnes’ The Long Run. Grassroots supporters like you have helped defeat the GOP and special interests in the past, and I need your support again as we take on this new fight.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.-45zWj&refcode=em240223-1-t12&t=26&akid=5221%2E196590%2EPvSZQa)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

subject: Great sandwiches and mean people

body:
Nowhere is more important than PA.
Hi Peter, it’s Jon Lovett. I love Pennsylvania.
It’s home to Philly, the city that dares to ask the question: what’s the opposite of Southern hospitality?
One thing I learned about myself by visiting the Commonwealth is that I don’t care how you treat me, as long as the sandwiches are good, and you’ve got the best sandwiches in the country. (Cry about it, Chicago.)
Pennsylvania is also home to Bob Casey, who’s facing a tough re-election.
The senior Senator is up against David McCormick, an out-of-towner rich guy (PA Republicans sure do have a type) who supports extreme abortion bans with no exceptions for rape or incest.
This guy could self-fund this race and has a bunch of right-wing money hanging over the race like a piano on a fraying string. Republicans could spend _hundreds of millions of dollars_ in PA to flip this seat red.
[**That’s why I’m doing one of these classic emails asking you to chip in a few dollars to support Senator Bob Casey’s re-election campaign, because we need to do everything we can to help him win.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240223-1?refcode=em20240223-1&refcode2=2083_552475_EBSZJD&akid=2083%2E552475%2EEBSZJD)

subject: why we killed the "library bill"
body:
🪦🪦🪦🪦🪦🪦🪦🪦🪦🪦 |
---
| | We killed a library bill dead on the Senate floor yesterday...

18-17 was the vote count.

But... _why?_

Well, in an odd turn of events, all but one Democrat joined with conservatives to kill it for two different reasons.

The Dems didn't like it because they don't think there's a problem with libraries or porn on the shelves.

We killed it because the bill we got (which was preceded by a lot of pressure, shenanigans, and arm-twisting) didn't protect kids or families... it protected libraries.

Because it created a 14-step process that could cost tens of thousands of dollars and take years to remove a single book:

[](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=5cbd537fa6&e=dea908e0fe) Crazy, right?!

That red tape would be enough to dissuade almost any parent from even trying (let alone, retaining a lawyer to help them do it).

We wanted to fix or amend it, but the bill sponsors wouldn't budge an inch.

**_So, we killed it._**

It deserved to die, and I'm glad it did.

Because the library bills that came before it went straight to the issue, held libraries accountable, and didn't require parents to be the new "library police."

For example, House Bill 666 (I know, scary) from 2022.

It solved the problem and passed the House. But the Senate wouldn't even HEAR IT afterward.

Why not bring that one back?

Because it eliminated the provision in Idaho law (that exists as you're reading this) to let libraries, schools, and museums give porn to kids LEGALLY.

Yep, that's Idaho LAW!

So, why not just get rid of that section of code?

Easy, right?

There are other ideas too. Ones that don't make parents hire lawyers and spend tens of thousands of dollars to remove a single book.

But the bill yesterday... was a compromised bill pushed onto the sponsors by leadership and run by a guy in the Senate who openly admitted he didn't even think libraries had an issue with obscene materials in the first place.

Let's do better.

Our kids deserve it.

Cheers,

Brian

**P.S.**

| Fellow Patriot,

You've probably noticed that children today aren't getting the same kind of education that you and I received when we were growing up.

We used to be taught to love our nation, cherish our history, and respect our fellow Americans. But all of that has changed.

In today's classroom, children are taught that America is fundamentally racist, that our history is one of oppression, and that we should focus on our differences instead of what unites us.

[[](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyUkT2L3DAQhn-N3NnII60sFy6W2yyEcOFIk1Jox3M-cfpCksnfD0ouTbpr5_2A552fz-bZOu_i8d0G2t6xmFJNtMaiG71rzdOYbSsutWqAgxw5jCDMPOzbvqKyaqBtXrhe-MIvfHjbllVqvazrZVY7aP4grVeJsMgHR4lSDW7rPRxAzGq-gJ4EyFe7zq9ApFfiC5PceipteifKmOJRqNZC-Xx4hzZOmMLgt7fWcmXiyuDO4F4Jz0KTDVS6B1OJVGpLkaZUDgb3_1jGls4y7inaRkzczxYM2pCtOyITN5-7zED1e01nQWLilkuqmbC5eHxIgXZ3BiZuFKzzDNRfr8G098D16WsH_fLCufhIYIqNYmPi9nIdvz39GP9tMZRtz7-c966qvsDRG_-gtk985XcAAAD__2_Al_Y)
__To make matters worse: the right of parents to choose how and where their kids receive their education remains out of reach for most American families.

And this is exactly why we created our Little Patriots program--to give parents, grandparents, teachers, and caregivers a free online resource they can use to teach children unbiased civics lessons, history, and American values, anywhere and anytime--[completely free of charge.](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyUkT2L3DAQhn-N3NnII60sFy6W2yyEcOFIk1Jox3M-cfpCksnfD0ouTbpr5_2A552fz-bZOu_i8d0G2t6xmFJNtMaiG71rzdOYbSsutWqAgxw5jCDMPOzbvqKyaqBtXrhe-MIvfHjbllVqvazrZVY7aP4grVeJsMgHR4lSDW7rPRxAzGq-gJ4EyFe7zq9ApFfiC5PceipteifKmOJRqNZC-Xx4hzZOmMLgt7fWcmXiyuDO4F4Jz0KTDVS6B1OJVGpLkaZUDgb3_1jGls4y7inaRkzczxYM2pCtOyITN5-7zED1e01nQWLilkuqmbC5eHxIgXZ3BiZuFKzzDNRfr8G098D16WsH_fLCufhIYIqNYmPi9nIdvz39GP9tMZRtz7-c966qvsDRG_-gtk985XcAAAD__2_Al_Y)

**And now we plan to do even more.**

To meet the growing demand for educational resources that teach children to love their country and its history, we're taking Little Patriots on the road to bring these educational resources to schools, churches, and community organizations!

But to help us fund this coast-to-coast effort, I need your help today.

We depend on the generous support of patriots like you to help us fund this program and share it with children and families across our great nation.

If you believe that American children deserve to receive the best education possible, [can I personally ask you to help me accomplish my goal of getting this first-of-its-kind curriculum to anyone who needs it?](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyUkT2L3DAQhn-N3NnII60sFy6W2yyEcOFIk1Jox3M-cfpCksnfD0ouTbpr5_2A552fz-bZOu_i8d0G2t6xmFJNtMaiG71rzdOYbSsutWqAgxw5jCDMPOzbvqKyaqBtXrhe-MIvfHjbllVqvazrZVY7aP4grVeJsMgHR4lSDW7rPRxAzGq-gJ4EyFe7zq9ApFfiC5PceipteifKmOJRqNZC-Xx4hzZOmMLgt7fWcmXiyuDO4F4Jz0KTDVS6B1OJVGpLkaZUDgb3_1jGls4y7inaRkzczxYM2pCtOyITN5-7zED1e01nQWLilkuqmbC5eHxIgXZ3BiZuFKzzDNRfr8G098D16WsH_fLCufhIYIqNYmPi9nIdvz39GP9tMZRtz7-c966qvsDRG_-gtk985XcAAAD__2_Al_Y)

If you'd like to help me get Little Patriots to more American children, please click the link below to make your generous tax-deductible gift today:

[**https://secure.americancornerstone.org/little-patriots-tour-donate**](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyUkT2L3DAQhn-N3NnII60sFy6W2yyEcOFIk1Jox3M-cfpCksnfD0ouTbpr5_2A552fz-bZOu_i8d0G2t6xmFJNtMaiG71rzdOYbSsutWqAgxw5jCDMPOzbvqKyaqBtXrhe-MIvfHjbllVqvazrZVY7aP4grVeJsMgHR4lSDW7rPRxAzGq-gJ4EyFe7zq9ApFfiC5PceipteifKmOJRqNZC-Xx4hzZOmMLgt7fWcmXiyuDO4F4Jz0KTDVS6B1OJVGpLkaZUDgb3_1jGls4y7inaRkzczxYM2pCtOyITN5-7zED1e01nQWLilkuqmbC5eHxIgXZ3BiZuFKzzDNRfr8G098D16WsH_fLCufhIYIqNYmPi9nIdvz39GP9tMZRtz7-c966qvsDRG_-gtk985XcAAAD__2_Al_Y)

**Hudson: Federal Budget is Job #1 for Rep. Scholten & Colleagues****— GOP Challenger Suggests New Approach to Fix Congress’ Annual Budget Failure —**
**Grand Rapids, MI** — “The very first priority of Congress should be timely passing a budget for the federal government. But Congresswoman Scholten and her colleagues have failed at job #1 not just this year—but every year this century,” observed Paul Hudson, the GOP candidate running against Scholten. In the nearly five decades that the current system for budgeting and spending tax dollars has been in place, Congress has passed all its required appropriations measures on time only four times: fiscal 1977 (the first full fiscal year under the current system), 1989, 1995 and 1997. The last three times, Congress was late in passing the budget blueprint that, in theory, precedes the actual spending bills. [[1](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=ce8f9f9bd8&e=26f66c7cbd)]
Hudson stated, “This is no way to run a government. Congress’ track record on budgeting is abysmal and demands a new approach. So here’s what I propose: Since Members of Congress only react to crises or deadlines, let’s change the process to push up the deadline requiring Congress to spend the first quarter of every year focused exclusively on the budget. No leaving DC until it’s done.”
“There’s no reason Rep. Scholten and her colleagues should be taking overseas trips, playing politics, or recessing for weeks at a time before they complete their most basic responsibility that taxpayers sent them to Washington to do.” “The budget process has been amended before and obviously needs reform. Why not require Members to concentrate the first 90 days of the year on producing a federal budget and refrain from anything that is not budget-related until the job is done? The Constitution gave the power of the purse – the nation's checkbook – to Congress, so there’s no reason for delay. People are fed up with this endless cycle of government shutdowns and kicking the can down the road. These reforms would ensure that Representatives like Hillary Scholten who claim they're laser focused on the job, actually complete the work of the people,“ remarked Hudson. “It’s time to try something new. Could we really do any worse than the annual mess Congress presides over?” asked Hudson.
The Republican challenger noted that for fiscal year 2024 the House has passed just 7 of 12 appropriation bills, while the Senate has only approved 3 of 12. A West Michigan resident and lifelong Michigander, Paul Hudson is seeking the Republican nomination for Congress in the state's Third District. The GOP primary election for United States House of Representatives is Tuesday, August 6, 2024.

I remember this day like it was yesterday.
I was 12 years old when I got to see a new president inaugurated in front of the Capitol building while the old one flew off on a helicopter from the back. I watched in awe as he took his oath of office. And just like that, a new era, a new vision, a new party, and a million new opportunities began, and the air was buzzing with hope.
That day has stuck with me. I've been in awe of that remarkable transition of power ever since. Through good presidents and bad, I've always looked forward to heading to the ballot box and choosing _whichever candidate I want_ , because that memory has always reminded me that my voice matters.
Until now – until this Republican candidate came along who won't accept when he loses fair and square, who runs on vengeance and leveling up scores, and who threatens every single bit of progress we've made since long before I witnessed that inauguration.
**I no longer sit on the sidelines and hope for the best. I can't anymore. And neither can you.**

Instead of waiting and hoping, I decided to take action.
I love doing trainings and volunteering and hanging out with friends at canvass kickoffs. But after a while, I realized the things that I believe in – the things that make me a progressive through and through – things like a sustainable environment, equity and equal rights, the right to make my own decisions about my body, and having security and dignity in old age with Medicare and Social Security were getting chipped away bit by bit. Sometimes with a scalpel and sometimes with a hammer. Every time new headlines appeared showing how these rights were being systematically destroyed, my heart broke just a little more.
But, I was determined to turn my heartbreak into change. I'd worked in nonprofits all my life, but when I saw that my values weren't being represented by my elected officials, I decided to jump all in with Movement Labs and use my skills to give tired activists in red states and rural communities a voice, to tell young people they're not too young to run for local office, to tell frustrated parents grumbling about their city council that they can run and become the City Councilor themselves.

clean_body: | | | I'm proud I get to work with impassioned and dedicated folks like Sarah, and I encourage you to check out her story below on how she wound up working with candidates and activists on the frontlines. If, like her, you've found that you don't want to sit on the sidelines because there's too much at stake in this election – from the state legislature to the White House – = Thanks for everything you do, Yoni Forwarded Message | I remember this day like it was yesterday. I was 12 years old when I got to see a new president inaugurated in front of the Capitol building while the old one flew off on a helicopter from the back. I watched in awe as he took his oath of office. And just like that, a new era, a new vision, a new party, and a million new opportunities began, and the air was buzzing with hope. That day has stuck with me. I've been in awe of that remarkable transition of power ever since. Through good presidents and bad, I've always looked forward to heading to the ballot box and choosing whichever candidate I want , because that memory has always reminded me that my voice matters. Until now – until this Republican candidate came along who won't accept when he loses fair and square, who runs on vengeance and leveling up scores, and who threatens every single bit of progress we've made since long before I witnessed that inauguration. I no longer sit on the sidelines and hope for the best. I can't anymore. And neither can you. = = Instead of waiting and hoping, I decided to take action. I love doing trainings and volunteering and hanging out with friends at canvass kickoffs. But after a while, I realized the things that I believe in – the things that make me a progressive through and through – things like a sustainable environment, equity and equal rights, the right to make my own decisions about my body, and having security and dignity in old age with Medicare and Social Security were getting chipped away bit by bit. Sometimes with a scalpel and sometimes with a hammer. Every time new headlines appeared showing how these rights were being systematically destroyed, my heart broke just a little more. But, I was determined to turn my heartbreak into change. I'd worked in nonprofits all my life, but when I saw that my values weren't being represented by my elected officials, I decided to jump all in with Movement Labs and use my skills to give tired activists in red states and rural communities a voice, to tell young people they're not too young to run for local office, to tell frustrated parents grumbling about their city council that they can run and become the City Councilor themselves. People deserve better, and that's a motto I've been committed to since I was 12 years old. It's time to take action. = Onward to November, Sarah Sarah Long Director of Development Movement Labs Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for by Rapid Resist Action. My opponent represents the same kind of far-right extremism that controls the GOP leadership in the House. We don’t need another yes-man for Mike Johnson and the rest of the GOP who consistently stop us from passing meaningful legislation and threaten a government shutdown that would put thousands of Americans at risk. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Remember when progressive Rep. Rashida Tlaib, the only
Palestinian-American member of Congress, was formally censured for
expressing support for Palestinian human rights?

Well, this week, Republican Rep. Andy Ogles of Tennessee made an
*actually* violent and genocidal comment when asked about innocent
Palestinian children being killed in Gaza: “We should kill them all.”

It’s absolutely disgusting for a sitting Congressmember to speak of
innocent people, especially children, this way. And yet, he hasn’t been
censured. The statement has barely even made news in mainstream media
outlets.

Ogles made this horrific call for mass murder on the same day that the
U.S. once again cast the sole vote against a United Nations resolution
calling for an immediate ceasefire in Gaza, as the civilian casualty count
grows day by day.

All of this further goes to show that we cannot lose the voices of
courageous, pro-peace leaders like Rashida and the rest of the Squad in
Congress — but AIPAC and its GOP donors are working harder than ever to
unseat them in this year’s primary elections that begin in April.

Justice Democrats is committed to re-electing the Squad and defending our
young, diverse, working-class bloc of progressives in Congress — but we
don’t have millions of dollars from corporate special interests and
billionaires like AIPAC does. We have you.

Congress right now is “controlled” by the Republican party – but you wouldn’t think so based on all their name-calling, infighting, and general inability to run the government.

Last week, they left Washington and went home on a recess without passing a budget for Fiscal Year 2024, without passing foreign aid funding to support our allies, and without passing legislation securing our border or addressing immigration.

This is why we can’t trust Republicans at any level of government – and why it’s so important that we elect strong Democrats to office across our state. [**If we want to get anything done, we need to do it ourselves – and that’s why we’re working so hard to build our party and recruit strong candidates.
