Our border is in crisis. Our immigration system is broken. Vladimir Putin is attacking our democracy and our allies. Congress won't be able to pay its bills come March. And where are Darin LaHood, Mike Bost, and Mary Miller? They're at home while their leader meets with indicted ex-President Donald Trump.

Republicans said ‘fix the border.’ Republicans and Democrats came up with a bipartisan bill, and then Republicans in the House said ‘just kidding.’

The federal government is operating under a continuing resolution until March 1st and March 8th, and the U.S. House is on recess until February 25th. That leaves just a few days for the Republicans to fund the government and keep the country running.

If Democrats were in charge, we wouldn’t be in this situation. This is why it’s so critical that we recruit, train and support great candidates at all levels of government — because when Republicans in Congress let us down, we need Democrats in our state committed to picking up the pieces and getting things done. [**Make a contribution right now to support our work and help us elect Democrats everywhere →**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79581186/456898045/-1541719890?refcode=IDCCA_EMAIL_230224_FR_Press-release&amount=20&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDU1NzIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2E5ZWRjZmEtNmNkMi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=nahNk9BPvDzTCYsk99Tay_KMV1wJMKNMi8hyFUiucrU=)

The American people know better, and expect better than Republican inaction. Stop the games. Get serious. Fix the problem. And get back to work.

Thanks,

Mark Guethle

It is already affecting _all of our daily lives_ — and things will keep getting worse unless we take historic, **decisive action.** **[Peter, I hope you’ll let me explain, but if you believe we need to send a proven climate warrior to Congress, please make a contribution to my campaign today →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79584406/456904870/-106617006?refcode=AU_AHC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240223_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2IyYzI3NDUtNmZkMi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YY8Hw_TFdMurjM42UDx_VuG0sYgpA4jbEiO0oyhez5g=)** For me, the climate crisis is _personal._ I began my career working in the White House for then-Vice President Al Gore to sound the alarm on the climate crisis. We made it possible for millions of Americans to move billions of dollars from savings deposits and personal investments out of Big Oil companies' reach and into fossil fuel-free accounts. And it can be the home of a bright, prosperous, clean energy future. | = Hi Peter, There’s no question about it: Arizona is ground zero when it comes to the climate crisis. All you have to do is watch the never-ending news coverage of natural disasters happening nationwide or, in Arizona’s case, just step outside in the heat during the summer to feel the effects of climate change. And if you’ve been part of my campaign since the beginning, you know it is one of the main reasons I'm running for Congress. It is already affecting all of our daily lives — and things will keep getting worse unless we take historic, decisive action. = For me, the climate crisis is personal. I began my career working in the White House for then-Vice President Al Gore to sound the alarm on the climate crisis. As a businessperson, I spent nearly a decade providing an environmentally-focused alternative to the Wall Street Big Banks that put climate change fighting power into people's hands. We made it possible for millions of Americans to move billions of dollars from savings deposits and personal investments out of Big Oil companies' reach and into fossil fuel-free accounts. This isn’t some abstract or global issue for us here in Arizona. We’re facing the climate crisis right here and right now. Wildfires, drought, and deadly heat waves have become all too common. There is no place in America where the climate crisis is a more present danger than in Arizona. But Arizona should also be the “Solar State.” We can be to clean energy jobs what Detroit is to cars and Silicon Valley is to computers. With the right leadership and vision in Congress, meeting the climate crisis can be an enormous source of economic opportunity for Arizona and America. Peter,

I’m sickened by the recent attacks on women’s reproductive health:

**Donald Trump – who my far-right opponent recently endorsed – backed a national abortion ban.** If he’s elected president again and the House remains in Republican hands, it’s clear no one will stop him.

**The Alabama Supreme Court ruled that frozen embryos created through in vitro fertilization are considered children under state law** – and at least three fertility facilities have paused new IVF treatments in the state.

**Birth control and contraception are next in the line of Republican fire.** The corrupt and conservative-majority U.S. Supreme Court will soon hear arguments on mifepristone access, the commonly used abortion pill.

Let me be clear: If Republicans regain the House majority, ALL women will be at risk. No state will be “safe” for women’s bodily autonomy.

name: Del. Jazz Lewis
subject: Jazz with Jazz: February Newsletter
body:
Team,

January may have ushered in a chill, but the legislative furnace is cranked up. Pleasantries are done, debates are on, and it's time to turn ideas into real-world results.

Last session with control of the legislature, it wasn’t partisan deadlock like our federal counterparts, here in Annapolis we were securing victories for Maryland families. Our policies combined with immediate economic impact will continue to build a stronger Maryland.

We didn't just patch a hole, we built a bridge. Making the COVID-era expansion to the Maryland Earned Income Tax Credit permanent, we delivered crucial, lasting support to families who need it most, empowering them to raise their children and build brighter futures.

While providing support to families now, we also empowered our future by opening doors and engaging youth in public service. Now, young Marylanders graduating can launch their careers while giving back to their communities through the Governor’s Service Year program. It’s a win-win, shaping brighter futures for individuals and recruiting talent into public service.

As the recently appointed Vice-Chair of the Capital Budget Subcommittee on Appropriations, I’m proud of the $246 million in capital improvements that we were able to secure for Prince George’s County in last year's budget. This wasn't just about bricks and mortar, it was about creating jobs, revitalizing communities, and providing world-class learning environments for Maryland's students. But there is still more to do and I'm working hard with my fellow committee members to ensure our community has the resources it needs.

This session, we're doubling down on progress with initiatives that benefit you, your family, and our community. Here are three of our policy priorities for the 90 days we get in the legislature to make an impact:
*
Carbon
Capture
Program:
This
program
helps
businesses
capture
carbon,
creating
jobs,
attracting
investment,
and
combating
climate
change
–
a
win
for
today
and
tomorrow.
*
Preventing
Bias
in
Artificial
Intelligence:
We
deserve
AI
that's
fair
and
unbiased.
This
bill
ensures
equal
opportunities
for
all,
protecting
communities
of
color,
and
unlocking
the
true
potential
of
AI
for
a
more
just
and
equitable
Maryland.
*
Banning
Legacy
Admissions:
This
legislation
boldly
puts
an
end
to
the
practice
of
considering
family
connections
in
college
admissions
allowing
students
to
be
measured
on
merit
rather
than
influence
for
the
Maryland's
educational
system.
These are just some of the ways we're building a brighter future for our state. We appreciate your help in making Maryland a place where opportunity flourishes, innovation thrives, and everyone has a chance to shine!
In solidarity,
Jazz
As a proven progressive leader and champion of issues ranging from criminal justice reform to healthcare access and economic equity, Jazz has represented the 24th Legislative District in Maryland’s House of Delegates since 2017. He also serves as Majority Whip of the Maryland House. A lifelong Prince Georgian, Jazz lives in Bowie with his wife and two kids.
By AUthority Friends of Jazz Lewis, Treasurer Chris Taitt

I’ve said it time and again, but the proof is in the pudding: China is coming for us, and they’re not knocking on the door—they’re waltzing right in. The chaotic mess at our southern border continues to drag on, but now there’s a major plot twist. According to Customs and Border Protection (CBP), they’re seeing more [Chinese migrants](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3a9cc2425b7f40e59f75fc68acb870b4&_e=Ai9107wZIONYQEvv4h6tQL5rq5O7qX2GNV5wPca1V2KB2vw1MpDgzqi8A4LJzXJSuGK2a0Pq-fiz0BR8v7luT43cFVK_f1KkJ_kptuDxsth0Jy1wNKT9eSkudL1dl9dPNakJgvdZ33wMX6Q59i37XUeLfiZQ1tX42QwTR78fo1rV1SdxI-Gu9YyHOBWUTC8DZ1MnxXi866wQQbayS3YkD8BgYUcMdofL2qZCvyv33F2BkUUYpq2HyHet0eBYh7WmSp4dzX0Wxrjcqn0KnVagbGmkqOTnCL5iSJ7g4rGUmDD3GNl4bFN0nfm-tDpJe_jZ) in the San Diego sector than Mexican nationals. To add fuel to the fire, most Chinese border-crossers are single adult men of military age. Take a moment to let this sink in. These aren't women and children seeking refuge from a communist government; these are [grown men](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3a9cc2425b7f40e59f75fc68acb870b4&_e=Ai9107wZIONYQEvv4h6tQFzB1o59DWNaWwrxVTMEzB-aiackJphZYEWNJXelp-thJOBQVW7eb1PDOzFpgr1YYnRWhUb7tZdQGGEqnUk0zR8xvIE61El_-dZg-Mn26_WkqACoAdUcdUqfF-lQlBtggAsrcVbSnYZbfhI10bjs4MkiKm7T8DucVxnRz6CPuEoskl5fgO6M0S5UIfRniEGl9UKOKrsvONbcPmamXzwUgyWkA47tVxbDzY5bOQaG7RLrgAsxnYku7aqq6buiBv79cg_7EhuwCaowId1hDsHFrWOJBYPzpQQLO7x3zoS3Wzir) of fighting age. Just saying it out loud sends chills down my spine, and that's not the only way they’re trying to weasel into our country. Just last week, [leaked Chinese hacking documents](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3a9cc2425b7f40e59f75fc68acb870b4&_e=Ai9107wZIONYQEvv4h6tQMu8QvhrVKbv6vf3_F2AGHjlk5z17f8lron1D3CoksTaoVhyk6Fy375Bx7UFxxMFYqxtcKIxmqEB_dS0iHZdXX78u25msF-smthOK4W20_0icuHL74PnHBKAyW4JCHrgid5rsYY0gQXr2PRj0XIgBxQmwjfoRoBwsEz_5i8R04LJSXcT3Dv2s6OgpvDOAgTEZbPjlfu4BikEC0k0GVkJN53Stl1l04ewl378gCXX_XGQRCZO2-ndtVvVo1CiMj6JRQlbZDfRZ_gVOXdl9GGQq-kQAjfgaVCz4BtWbJQVr8oD) gave us a peek into just how far-reaching and powerful China's hacking operations can be. From government agencies to businesses, they've got a tight grip on their targets worldwide—and it'd be downright foolish to think we’re not at the top of that list. Consider the AT&T; outage that made headlines yesterday. With tens of thousands of customers, this fiasco sent our country into full-blown panic mode. The company says it was due to a [software update](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3a9cc2425b7f40e59f75fc68acb870b4&_e=Ai9107wZIONYQEvv4h6tQKwagIDzdv30gWIDL9_nitxC7bAOvugzNTSwq70IVdqNByRSXKe6Y7wBGPFAwONTdM92xRmE5xZt1u7ZDWvKap45t8jVz_saM90Wcn8y-2BRkeHfrkItxVAKGmMR3LJspC0qDtjxjbo7fpuV4oyz0CmsJPXs6bqXZG10gIso877LFJXjymuZ20vgwmML3Y8Iu1ddOgJ0EA192ruPENAUbwZCJDSwORR3YQckL5VjVHDFckbHbIBBPTwyfHH46AY6_FS20P5urO_SlL670_fl78s%3D) gone wrong, and I trust that what they say is true—but what about next time? As [Sen. Marco Rubio](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3a9cc2425b7f40e59f75fc68acb870b4&_e=Ai9107wZIONYQEvv4h6tQL5rq5O7qX2GNV5wPca1V2LXh9D1W2tw-Npyxc8J2Im253zggKqgxFLpjltq5HcXXWNQhAnxjvLV6UwBjjrS9w9VujACkClcRpP0lbjaMJsQfkaqb3-7WWjFcOx-Sxp_vQRQNDsUkA0ICXdk6HoB5JzRVv6IWGCMcou5XZ1gDKd6IkZLnZie3aDMiske08CQZK7OuMfDPl2pwznxSpqsObh8Itkk-7_Y0oAm-QjU7SsjpSmzVypaS3NzSJDsCkURe1C1hvJjOfHeW8Fdcbm2rXrnkLvIxTHur2b_8gcHH2z0) warned, this was a blip on the radar compared to what a Chinese cyberattack would unleash. If they're coming for us, they're after much more than our cell service. Their sophisticated hacking could potentially disrupt everything we hold near and dear, from power and water to our entire banking systems. Democrats have consistently turned a blind eye to China’s shenanigans, and I, for one, have had enough. For heaven’s sake, they sent a dadgum [spy balloon](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3a9cc2425b7f40e59f75fc68acb870b4&_e=Ai9107wZIONYQEvv4h6tQB8eSdqF0hf8KA-ErTEr5yGLJGSzXwpoXIKkLFvw8Z-qj29zwrAOiS-PGgwneWA1qg1MIb_HPmBaQW6of0eFsNjGzYaLv82p1Ltp9mgN6CoCAZHC4Y0pG52j0pN-XALMUxNBzB6rc2cj9dWV3VEohHYqQIQzfyJxdmw9nGXVOK1pjkYPCfMRUCdKsmgM0voM0XHI68BbLKioezBdR6aN--wqkIn-m0WTJP73054W_IK3) into our country’s airspace and didn’t even get a slap on the wrist. The alarm bells are ringing so loud I can’t hear myself think. We can’t let Biden and his fellow Democrats continue to drag us down a path where we end up at the mercy of the Communist Chinese. It’s high time we close the border, secure our cyber landscape, and tell China they’re barking up the wrong tree.

Robert J. Booker will forever be known as a revered [African American historian](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3a9cc2425b7f40e59f75fc68acb870b4&_e=Ai9107wZIONYQEvv4h6tQE6fAMcrYh9nEJNLiJxYQXVfbojwR5co78CiyqUXYWIzRV3OCAWWI7bHlJBVV7CEk_ZLAqjoZzTDrKtddhhGMTalZw1_uTddI6TVVE4T6kabVEbJbYs6unQiuXsFRD_oSpar00kBKbkhPtNZL7JXftMarzCbaL9CMC77nUeBcDagMRVHIOV8QD5oXWiAR7EDq05L0BPxDEH47uOImF0j3pz-gK8loQi5z25MVMuOE0WgFEkhucq_eEuhtwdpLNdbX1nkmgOwMz3B7yBbxZUiteZwku3ykX0oT8-DGmrlB-5_QUx3CUC3kPUvq9QrHRkhdQ%3D%3D) and one of the leaders of Knoxville’s Civil Rights Movement, leaving a mark on our community forever. I had the pleasure of knowing Bob personally for many years, and I’m happy to have so many fond memories of him. He worked with my dad at UT and knew my mama because she taught at Knoxville College. Bob’s hospitality knew no bounds, and he welcomed me into his home for many parties, which is why I can attest to his incredible record collection. But one of my fondest memories of Bob was in a good old-fashioned Tennessee honky-tonk, where he dedicated his karaoke song to Kelly and me as we were standing in the back. Beyond those personal moments, Bob was an icon who fought for what he believed in. That’s exactly why Joe Armstrong and I named a bridge after him when I was in the state legislature. He will be missed, but there’s no denying the impact he had on our community. I know his legacy will be talked about and celebrated for generations to come.

clean_body: TIMtalk will keep you updated on the important issues and goings-on in our campaign, in Tennessee, and in our country.| | | | | **China’s Sneaky Moves 👀 | | I’ve said it time and again, but the proof is in the pudding: China is coming for us, and they’re not knocking on the door—they’re waltzing right in. The chaotic mess at our southern border continues to drag on, but now there’s a major plot twist. According to Customs and Border Protection (CBP), they’re seeing more in the San Diego sector than Mexican nationals. To add fuel to the fire, most Chinese border-crossers are single adult men of military age. Take a moment to let this sink in. These aren't women and children seeking refuge from a communist government; these are of fighting age. Just saying it out loud sends chills down my spine, and that's not the only way they’re trying to weasel into our country. Just last week, gave us a peek into just how far-reaching and powerful China's hacking operations can be. From government agencies to businesses, they've got a tight grip on their targets worldwide—and it'd be downright foolish to think we’re not at the top of that list. Consider the AT&T; outage that made headlines yesterday. With tens of thousands of customers, this fiasco sent our country into full-blown panic mode. The company says it was due to a gone wrong, and I trust that what they say is true—but what about next time? As warned, this was a blip on the radar compared to what a Chinese cyberattack would unleash. If they're coming for us, they're after much more than our cell service. Their sophisticated hacking could potentially disrupt everything we hold near and dear, from power and water to our entire banking systems. Democrats have consistently turned a blind eye to China’s shenanigans, and I, for one, have had enough. For heaven’s sake, they sent a dadgum into our country’s airspace and didn’t even get a slap on the wrist. The alarm bells are ringing so loud I can’t hear myself think. We can’t let Biden and his fellow Democrats continue to drag us down a path where we end up at the mercy of the Communist Chinese. It’s high time we close the border, secure our cyber landscape, and tell China they’re barking up the wrong tree. | | | | | Remembering A Knoxville Legend 🧡 | | It’s with a heavy heart that we bid farewell to in the Knoxville community. Robert J. Booker will forever be known as a revered and one of the leaders of Knoxville’s Civil Rights Movement, leaving a mark on our community forever. I had the pleasure of knowing Bob personally for many years, and I’m happy to have so many fond memories of him. He worked with my dad at UT and knew my mama because she taught at Knoxville College. Bob’s hospitality knew no bounds, and he welcomed me into his home for many parties, which is why I can attest to his incredible record collection. But one of my fondest memories of Bob was in a good old-fashioned Tennessee honky-tonk, where he dedicated his karaoke song to Kelly and me as we were standing in the back. Beyond those personal moments, Bob was an icon who fought for what he believed in. That’s exactly why Joe Armstrong and I named a bridge after him when I was in the state legislature. He will be missed, but there’s no denying the impact he had on our community. body:
With the primary coming up, I’m busier than ever, and there’s a lot of pressure on my campaign to raise the money we need to hold this seat.
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79591173/456922186/938567526?refcode=header&noskip=true&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Nzg0ZDc5MC03OGQyLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxv5Bqr3kb7v3lrcTvcwPKE6WxoTVX4vQOU1kgL_XFo=)
Friends,
With the primary coming up, I’m busier than ever, and there’s a lot of pressure on my campaign to raise the money we need to hold this seat. But before I ask for your support, I want to tell you about a decision I made when I first ran for Congress that informs our entire strategy.
Something you may not know is that, unlike most members of Congress, my campaign rejects corporate PAC money. It likely costs my campaign tens, or potentially hundreds, of thousands of dollars, but it’s important to me.
I want people to know when I ask for their vote that they can trust I will always put my constituents first. I ran for Congress to be a voice for families just like mine — to hold power accountable, level the playing field and call out corruption wherever it may exist.
I believe in true grassroots campaigns because power comes from the bottom up. But that means I also need folks like you to chip in. That’s the only way we can raise the resources to hold this seat and take back our majority.
**[If you believe in me, I’m asking you to have my back today by pitching in any amount you can before the primary on March 5. I cannot do this alone.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79591174/456922187/764803318?refcode2=8784d790-78d2-ee11-85f9-002248223794&refcode=em240223&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Nzg0ZDc5MC03OGQyLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxv5Bqr3kb7v3lrcTvcwPKE6WxoTVX4vQOU1kgL_XFo=)**
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79591175/456922188/764803318?refcode2=8784d790-78d2-ee11-85f9-002248223794&refcode=em240223&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Nzg0ZDc5MC03OGQyLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxv5Bqr3kb7v3lrcTvcwPKE6WxoTVX4vQOU1kgL_XFo=)**

With you by my side, we won’t let that happen.
Thank you!
Robert

That’s the only way we can raise the resources to hold this seat and take back our majority. = = There are a lot of extreme right-wing billionaires and corporate special interests that would love to defeat me and make an example out of me. With you by my side, we won’t let that happen. Thank you! Bills That Passed Out of the Senate
| | | | VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY WEEKLY RECAP SENATE
WEEK ENDING 2/23/24
---
---
| Friends, Only 2 more weeks to go before the Virginia Senate adjourns sine die on Saturday, March 9.
Each house has successfully passed their version of the budget as of yesterday, Thursday, February 22. Now a handful of legislators will work in conference to resolve the differences between the proposed House budget and the proposed Senate budget. Once agreed upon, a final budget will be voted on and agreed to.
Missing from both the Democrat controlled House and Senate budgets are key pieces of Governor Youngkin's proposed tax plan.
That plan would have reduced personal income tax and raised the state sales tax. Youngkin also recommended adding a sales tax on digital goods like streaming services to make up for any shortfalls.
However, most of Youngkin's tax plan was removed from the House and Senate budgets, except for the proposed sales tax on digital goods.
Below is a comprehensive list of bills that have failed and bills that passed out of the Senate.
If you desire to get more information on one of the bills listed below just click the button below for each committee and the bill history and summary is listed.
The Virginia General Assembly will reconvene on April 17 for consideration of the Governor's amendments and vetoes.
Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar.

clean_body: Bills That Passed Out of the Senate | | | | VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY WEEKLY RECAP SENATE WEEK ENDING 2/23/24 | Friends, Only 2 more weeks to go before the Virginia Senate adjourns sine die on Saturday, March 9. Each house has successfully passed their version of the budget as of yesterday, Thursday, February 22. Now a handful of legislators will work in conference to resolve the differences between the proposed House budget and the proposed Senate budget. Once agreed upon, a final budget will be voted on and agreed to. Missing from both the Democrat controlled House and Senate budgets are key pieces of Governor Youngkin's proposed tax plan. That plan would have reduced personal income tax and raised the state sales tax. Youngkin also recommended adding a sales tax on digital goods like streaming services to make up for any shortfalls. However, most of Youngkin's tax plan was removed from the House and Senate budgets, except for the proposed sales tax on digital goods. Below is a comprehensive list of bills that have failed and bills that passed out of the Senate. If you desire to get more information on one of the bills listed below just click the button below for each committee and the bill history and summary is listed. The Virginia General Assembly will reconvene on April 17 for consideration of the Governor's amendments and vetoes. Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar. | Please also consider following me on == for my real time daily posts regarding votes on controversial and significant impact bills. Hope you find my daily and weekly newsletter along with my Facebook posts helpful in following the General Assembly. | BILLS THAT PASSED OUT OF SENATE COMMITTEES HIGHLIGHTS | Want to know which Virginia House and Senate bills have either passed or failed this session? Below is a pretty comprehensive list. Notice the large number of gun control bills that have passed this session. I would recommend calling the Governor's office now to let them know your thoughts. **Join Us in Making a Difference**

Dear Peter,
Today, on International Stand Up to Bullying Day, our campaign in Washington's 8th District is taking a firm stand against bullying in all its forms. Bullying is not just a problem for individuals; it's a challenge that affects our schools, workplaces, and online communities. It goes against the very values of respect, dignity, and compassion that we hold dear.
As conservatives, we believe in the power of community, personal responsibility, and the importance of creating safe environments for everyone, especially the vulnerable. We are committed to advocating for policies that support anti-bullying programs, education, and resources that empower individuals to stand up against bullying and promote a culture of kindness and respect.

> Since a mass shooting targeting Former AZ Rep. Gabby Giffords took six of her constituents’ lives and nearly ended her own, Gabby’s work through her organization _Giffords_ has been one of the leading forces fighting the gun lobby, calling out lawmakers beholden to the NRA, and pushing Congress to take serious measures to end the gun violence epidemic.
>
> **_And Mad has been among the strongest allies in their work. Check out her track record pushing for progress and taking on the NRA:_**
> * As a PA State Legislator, Mad co-founded the gun safety group PA SAFE Caucus – authoring legislation for universal background checks, extreme risk protection orders, and a ban on “bump stocks”
>
>
> * She fought in Committee and on the House Floor to pass H.R. 8, which requires a background check for every firearm sale
>
>
> * Fought to pass H.R. 112, which enhances background check requirements for firearm transfers between different parties
>
>
> * Mad’s first bill introduced in Congress was to prohibit the possession of firearms that can’t be detected by walk-through metal detectors
>
>
> * Mad voted for the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, the most comprehensive gun safety legislation in decades
>
Bottom line: Giffords knows what we know — **Mad will continue to help pass common-sense legislation to protect children from weapons of war, increase background checks, and repeal federal laws that bar funding for research on gun violence as a public health issue.**

name: Sam Brown
subject: They blew up my body, but they’ll never destroy my spirit...
body:
You can never take away the heart of a soldier

| |
---
| | | Friend,

**[This was God's message for me.](http://links.theusapatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=662cfe458f124e3e83a57f35a3e7e146&_e=HytJk4pJCayddwCNKoFaU62EX4w9jH7OIPmSdoL6V5fYLqpBujCUcbr9KdgMwmKjMKkY6H_scbYsvnEeSLmYD87wredXrmO6TT0pHhKKS6vR8UZVBTB4d9aZo5483-UgcOx9ToVHvQVEvHzSjwn98g6Dp1lk1Bc_wlAhLzYDlguH7Vab-CFVBPhxLHZB4SpyED_QDvM7UTrLEkku8tqKtSsDNiHuX7BUORsYJ032uCAvsQLY-ouSR1OAtdCHdeYgTSMh_fJnVUBddcRg2JNceMQTKfXK8TkCCvSX5TihjSQMWwnufJjN_sTF4XIgEMMcL5bGlGt3RQA95_hXDOC1Fg%3D%3D "This was God’s message for me. ")**

I didn't know if I was going to survive -- but I knew if I did, my life would belong to Him forever.

In 2008, a roadside bomb in Afghanistan left me with burns over half my body. This was my vehicle after the explosion.

---
| [](http://links.theusapatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=662cfe458f124e3e83a57f35a3e7e146&_e=HytJk4pJCayddwCNKoFaU62EX4w9jH7OIPmSdoL6V5fYLqpBujCUcbr9KdgMwmKjMKkY6H_scbYsvnEeSLmYD87wredXrmO6TT0pHhKKS6vR8UZVBTB4d9aZo5483-UgcOx9ToVHvQVEvHzSjwn98g6Dp1lk1Bc_wlAhLzYDlguH7Vab-CFVBPhxLHZB4Spy3P49unyttgcmlic0K8Fq_nNujLfS03PLcz-PySieZ-Zyj8MEgep_F6udDBwYvqfi39eA4DI0fux0L8OywL3BHWgI7zhfiZiASS0dCiHbOqo3iMBh3O7SGRe9SL9L3neyuu40nWtaDtdu-nQuop_0JQ%3D%3D)
---

My path to recovery wasn't easy -- I spent months wondering if my life could ever be the same, asking myself why God spared me that day.

**But that was God 's way of speaking to me, THIS was His message to me...His plan for me.**

Friend, I realized that my life would NEVER be the same, but that was okay. I was alive for one reason:

_**My new life belonged not to me, but to Him.

That's why I've lived every day since with three things in mind: My country, my family, and God Himself. **_

God used the tragedy that resulted in my injuries to tell me something.

Through 3 years of recovery and over 30 surgeries- I was never alone. Not for one second.

God stayed with me through it all and he made it clear to me that I was NOT called to wish for my old life.

**Instead, I was called to live my new life to the fullest in service to Him.**

That's why I spent the last 15 years starting my family, serving fellow veterans through the business I started, and most recently, **[I launched my campaign to become the next U.S. Senator from Nevada.](http://links.theusapatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=662cfe458f124e3e83a57f35a3e7e146&_e=HytJk4pJCayddwCNKoFaU62EX4w9jH7OIPmSdoL6V5fYLqpBujCUcbr9KdgMwmKjMKkY6H_scbYsvnEeSLmYD87wredXrmO6TT0pHhKKS6vR8UZVBTB4d9aZo5483-UgcOx9ToVHvQVEvHzSjwn98g6Dp1lk1Bc_wlAhLzYDlguH7Vab-CFVBPhxLHZB4SpyiJLFd5wdixfHqbaCBvRt2Y7BsQOUwH62TlKEggl577dpui1xuNacrPtyQsfQnsGXDrsTGslI7C6T1xQr6y5sjimt6R1RGVainVsmOXGFzlbhE0av81FLXnInxQ6j5L5Oq6brjqnD-FFi1BFx7baJYA%3D%3D "I launched my campaign to become the next U.S. Senator from Nevada.")**

America is at a tipping point.

Corrupt leaders are leading us into total madness.

Our border is collapsing.

Parents are being cut-off from their children in schools.

We're spending away our future and the future of our children's children.

I'm running for U.S. Senate to bring a new generation of Conservative leadership to Washington D.C.

But to do that, Friend, I'll need your help.

So I'm hoping that you can help me with 1 or 2 things.

body:
Let me explain.
| | |
---
**Friend, as soon as I shook Rick Scott's hand, I knew that he wasn’t in this for Florida families. Let me explain.**
Back when he was running for governor the very first time, I got the chance to meet Rick Scott. Now, I wasn't a fan of his policies, but I tried my best to give him a fair chance — after all, I'd never write off someone just because of their political party.
**But as soon as I met him face to face and shook his hand, I knew that he couldn’t care less about the people of Florida — trust me, if you've ever met him, you know exactly what I'm talking about.** He lacks almost all empathy. Everything he does is about himself — increasing his wealth, increasing his power, and advancing his far-right agenda.
You don't have to just take it from me. His record more than speaks for itself.
Rick Scott made his fortune overseeing a massive Medicare fraud scheme. Somehow he managed to get off scot-free. Then, he used his massive fortune to buy his way into politics.
**Rick Scott has spent his entire time in public service lying to Americans.** He lied about the 2020 election. He lied about his position on abortion. He lied about my record. **And all the while, he's pushed policies to hurt the most hardworking and vulnerable Americans.** He tried to raise taxes on working families. He wrote the plan to end Medicare and Social Security for our seniors. He even said he would repeal _And throughout it all, he's gotten even richer._
My story is different. I came to America from Ecuador at 14 years old. My mom worked double shifts to make ends meet, and I picked up shifts at a doughnut shop to help out. I studied hard to win scholarships and put myself through college. After school, I dedicated my life to giving back to my community and my country, working at nonprofits across Florida and serving in Congress.
**My life has always been about service to others. Rick Scott's life is about service to himself. That's why I'm running for Senate to give Florida the leadership we deserve. | | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. body:
Let’s make decency great again. | | | | |
#### [View email in browser](https://mailchi.mp/f5918a1d610f/test-3bj3a7oq6q-443?e=b9b3f70fc1)
---
[](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=b6e1d157cc&e=b9b3f70fc1)
Hi Friend,
Donald Trump is a bully and a liar, and that puts him in some awful company.
Back in the 1950s, Senator Joseph McCarthy followed what we’d now call _the Trump playbook_ to insult, smear, and destroy his political enemies. For years, he launched reckless attack after reckless attack, and no one stood up to stop him.
**Until someone did — a lawyer named Joseph Welch.** When McCarthy started bullying one of Welch’s much younger colleagues, Welch had enough. And he ended McCarthy’s political career with a single question:

_Until this moment, Senator, I think I never really gauged your cruelty or your recklessness...**Have you no sense of decency?

**_ We all know about Donald Trump’s cruelty and recklessness — he shows them off constantly, like they’re something to be proud of. **But when the time comes to stand up and say “enough,” far-right MAGA congressmen like my opponent John Carter do the opposite.** They’re right there with Trump, throwing another tiki torch on the fire Trump’s setting to our institutions, norms, and values.

That’s not how my parents raised me. They taught me to stand up for my values — values like decency, but also honesty, integrity, humility, respect, and accountability. And I’ve taught the same thing to my sons. **Somewhere along the way, John Carter lost sight of those values.**
Where’s the honesty in lying that the 2020 election was stolen?

Where’s the integrity in voting to toss out those election results?

Where’s the humility in dismissing volumes of scientific evidence on climate change as a media hoax?

Where’s the respect in telling women they can’t make their own healthcare decisions?

Where’s the accountability in missing vote after vote after vote after vote, more than 100 times last session alone?
And above all — when John Carter has supported Trump through impeachments, an insurrection, indictments, and intimidation — one has to ask: _**Mr. Carter, have you no sense of decency?**_
**I’m running to replace John Carter because I have a sense of decency, and I know Texas voters do too.** Will you help me make decency great again?

[**Whatever you can contribute today will go a long way in helping me defeat Trump’s ally John Carter in November. With your support, we can stop the cruelty and recklessness that’s dominated Washington for much too long.**](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=2f9f8d8846&e=b9b3f70fc1)
| [Donate now ›››](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=25fe2c90fd&e=b9b3f70fc1)
---
When history looks back at politicians like Donald Trump and John Carter, it won’t be kind. **Let’s make sure history also says we stood up and said “enough.”

** With gratitude,
Stuart WhitlowDemocrat for U.S. Congress, TX-31
|
---
[](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=1316eac626&e=b9b3f70fc1)
Stuart Whitlow is a lifelong Democrat and a fifth-generation resident of TX-31 running to unseat Trump’s ally in Congress, MAGA Republican John Carter.
As a lawyer, Stuart has more than 35 years experience representing folks like us and taking on those in power. Now, he’s running for Congress to stand up for ALL Texans against the extremism of the MAGA movement.
Stuart’s opponent has put Trump’s interests ahead of America’s interests, and it’s wrecked havoc on Capitol Hill and here at home. Stuart knows that TX-31 needs a Congress that works for all us, not just for Donald Trump.
“We take care of each other here in Texas, and we deserve leaders in Congress who can be trusted to do the same. That's why I'm ready to fight for our values in Congress and stand up for ALL Texans. I'm asking for your support in the Democratic Primary on March 5th — so together, we can make sure our Texas values live on.”
— Stuart Whitlow
_Democrat for U.S. Congress, TX-31_

body:
The defense of Ukraine is critical to our own National Security, but this is about more than that.
#
Derek, tomorrow marks two years since Putin’s invasion of Ukraine.
The defense of Ukraine will save lives. It will uphold a democratic government. And it will push back against Putin's imperialist aims.
But much more than that, it will stop a war from spreading into Europe – from hitting our NATO allies – which may trigger our agreement to come to their defense, if attacked, just as they came to our defense on 9/11.
In short, helping Ukraine now is the best thing we can do to avoid US Troops being called to fight and die in a new war in Europe.
We’re doing whatever we can, wherever we can to get aid for Ukraine across the finish line in Congress.
One thing you can do to help is to continue escalating pressure on the GOP, especially in the House, to deliver that aid.
**[Please, if you care about helping Ukraine, add your name here and tell the GOP to send Ukraine the help they need to defend their country.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/240223_vv_em_ukraine/?source=em240223-1-30?refcode2=24922.3013755.4HU7CM&akid=24922%2E3013755%2E4HU7CM)

Friend, I have breaking news to share with you... We need full access to reproductive healthcare, but if we continue down this path Arizonans will struggle to even find an OBGYN. Hi friend,

I want to share a personal story with you about why I’m so energized to win this race against far-right extremist David Schweikert. [**I hope you’ll read the whole way through, then chip in $3 or any amount toward our February fundraising goal.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79602663/456960448/-401216107?refcode=em-2.23.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYwODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTY1M2FiZmEtOGZkMi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=rxwXxwqQ2j1C8qEntIxN1UGqo3_qEtOp6KveqK0APvk=)

I’m a proud first-generation American and the daughter of Cuban immigrants. My parents left Cuba in the 1960s to flee Fidel Castro’s communist dictatorship to give us a better life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79602664/456960449/-401216107?refcode=em-2.23.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYwODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTY1M2FiZmEtOGZkMi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=rxwXxwqQ2j1C8qEntIxN1UGqo3_qEtOp6KveqK0APvk=) _My mom, my daughter Ava, my aunt, and me._
Growing up, we didn’t have much. My dad worked multiple jobs to make sure we had food on the table and my mother worked in a factory sewing buttons and zippers.

She was excited when she got a better, higher-paying job at another factory. **But after only two months of working there she was fired because they found out she was pregnant with me.**

That was a pivotal moment for my parents and shaped my life even before I was born. Hard to imagine, but even today we’re still fighting for these same rights.

Running for office was never on my bingo card. But with the rise of Trumpism, the attacks on our democracy, and the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ – I knew I couldn’t stand by.

**I never imagined that our country – where my parents found a new life after fleeing from a dictator – could fall to the extremism we’re watching unfold today.**

Here in AZ-01, David Schweikert is one of the worst extremists in Congress. He doesn’t care about our community, instead, he’s a rubber stamp for Trump.

[**It’s time that our community has the fearless leadership we need to protect our freedoms. I’m running to defeat Schweikert and flip this seat from red to blue, but I need your help to keep our strong momentum. Will you chip in $3 toward our February fundraising goal?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79602671/456960450/-401216107?refcode=em-2.23.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYwODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTY1M2FiZmEtOGZkMi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=rxwXxwqQ2j1C8qEntIxN1UGqo3_qEtOp6KveqK0APvk=)

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=38137%2E3422442%2Eiehjtm)
Derek, yesterday Katie explained why special interests are on the verge of successfully ending her time in Congress. Today, a crypto super PAC launched *another* grossly-misleading attack ad against Katie. [**Can you chip in right now to help us respond?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240223-2?refcode=em20240223-38137&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38137_3422442_iehjtm&akid=38137%2E3422442%2Eiehjtm)
_Katie’s message from yesterday is below:_
* * *
**Let me be frank: We’re at serious risk of losing because of Adam Schiff’s dangerous play to boost a Republican into the top two. I’ll explain more below, but first:[Can you give $5 right now to help us pull ahead?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240223-2?refcode=em20240223-38137&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38137_3422442_iehjtm&akid=38137%2E3422442%2Eiehjtm)**
**In California’s primary, the top two vote-getters, regardless of party, advance to the general. While Adam Schiff is polling in first, Republican Steve Garvey and I are right behind him—battling for second.**
But Schiff has spent more than $10M boosting the Republican in this race. As the New York Times reported, “Mr. Schiff has perhaps done more to help Mr. Garvey than Mr. Garvey himself.”

subject: The NRA can bash me all they want
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
We aren’t backing down.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240223-1&t=1&akid=412%2E587540%2EYqyRNx)
Peter,
I noticed a familiar face in a recent issue of _American Rifleman_. (Yes, I really read it. You’ve got to keep your friends close and enemies closer, after all.)
To no one’s surprise, the NRA took out a full-page ad bashing me — and by extension, all of the folks who are a part of this movement to reform our gun laws, make progressive change, and elect the next generation of bold, young leaders.

body:
|
#
Peter, Did you know that campaigns like ours receive most of their grassroots donations in the week before Election Day, _at the very last minute?_ We understand why. clean_body: the largest public EV charging center in the country | | | | The Department of Transportation recently awarded Mount Vernon a $12.5 million grant to install 78 electric vehicle charging ports downtown at the Mount Vernon Library Commons — slated to be the largest public EV charging center in the country. This is another exciting development thanks to the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law for residents of Northwest Washington! And the list just keeps growing: as of November 2023, $7.9 billion has been invested with 490 projects identified for funding in Washington state. This latest grant is part of the Department of Transportation's Charging and Fueling Infrastructure Grant Program, and will help strategically deploy publicly accessible EV charging and alternative fueling infrastructure nationwide. Making electric vehicle charging easier will make these vehicles more appealing to consumers, and ultimately help cut down on fossil fuel emissions. I am a strong supporter of the Mount Vernon Library Commons project, which will feature a combined library, community center and parking structure that will house the EV charging center — and this effort has been a long time coming. Last May, I sent a letter to the Federal Highway Administration in support of the grant application, then requested a $3 million earmark in the 2024 spending bill to bolster construction costs for the Mount Vernon Library Commons project. I am excited to bring this project to our community soon. If it becomes law, the CHA would...
* Invest over $500 billion in federal programs that fund affordable housing
* Ensure that affordable housing remains affordable through a community land trust
* Eliminate barriers to the construction of affordable housing
* Support renters by funding emergency rental assistance programs
* And so much more!

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1167%2E135344%2Ey9-xIC)

Friends,
Want to see the height of hypocrisy on the IVF issue? Every GOP Senate candidate in the country is running away from the Alabama Supreme Court decision to ban the destruction of frozen embryos. As three clinics have already stopped IVF services in that state, GOP candidates across the country are starting to put out statements to say that the decision was wrong, and that they love growing families.
Former Congressman Mike Rogers put out a similar statement -- but he seems to have forgotten his own record on this very issue. In his 14 years in Congress, he co-sponsored four bills that would have had the same effect as the Alabama IVF ruling, making it impossible for millions of couples to have a family:
In 2013, Rogers pushed Rep. Jim Jordan’s HR 1091, the Life at Conception Act.
In 2009, Rogers and Jordan wrote HR 881, the Right to Life Act.
In 2008, Rogers and Jordan authored HR 618, the Right to Life Act.
In 2005, Rogers supported HR 552, the Right to Life Act.
All of these bills agree with the Alabama Supreme Court that a fertilized embryo cannot be disposed of.
Republicans in competitive Senate races are already rushing to say they’re supportive of IVF because they know that, like their stances on abortion, this type of stance could cost them a Senate seat. But we need to believe them when they show us over and over that this is who they are: It was never just about Roe. And they will continue chipping away at individual freedom as long as they have the power to do so.
These are deeply personal decisions for a family. Mike Rogers doesn’t belong anywhere near those decisions.
[**Elissa believes IVF is a vital option for families who are desperate to grow their families and bring a baby into this world. And, unlike so many others, she remembers and understands the votes she casts on these issues.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-feb24.z4X5uQ&refcode=em240223-1-700&t=2&akid=1167%2E135344%2Ey9-xIC)**

With less than two weeks until the primary election, our team of organizers are working harder than ever in every corner of our state, becuase we know that the House majority will run through California. | | **A Note from CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret)** Some analysts project that Senator Tim Kaine (D-VA) will be the key to Joe Biden and other Democrat victories in Virginia. But in the same breath, they warn that as the clear frontrunner, I bring to the table qualities where he lacks: diplomacy and national defense. It's a funny because Kaine has been riding everyone’s coat tails his entire career, so he and Biden depending on each other is like watching a dog chasing his own tail. They are two goofy guy banking on failed policies that led to economic decline, higher prices at the grocery store and gas pumps, an invasion at the Southern Border and two wars. This November, we have an opportunity to put an end to the disastrous Biden-Kaine administration once and for all. Tim Kaine has been a U.S. Senator for more than a decade, and the only thing anyone remembers is that he got stuck on I-95 in a snowstorm with a bottle of Dr. Pepper. If we want to save our country, we need real leaders who are people of action - not politicians and bureaucrats.\- CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret)

Last week, Hung Cao received the endorsement of Dick Heller, who bravely fought for his 2nd Amendment rights in the U.S. Supreme Court case _District of Columbia v. Heller_. Our 2nd Amendment rights have long since been under attack and Hung is a strong supporter of individuals' right to keep and bear Arms. | | This week, Hung Cao received the endorsement of LtCol Oliver North USMC (Ret.). In his endorsement, LtCol North stated: _"Hung Cao won't run from a fight. He never has. He never will. Though possessed of true humility, he won't 'play it safe' or deliver meaningless speeches or strive to be 'politically correct.' What Hung Cao will do is boldly employ his God-given gifts of faith, courage, experience and wisdom to become a leader in the U.S. Senate."_ Furthermore, he went on to say, _"Hung Cao is the most relevant person to address our present national crises. I know of no one more qualified to speak out against the socialist propaganda plaguing our military, education system, and culture. We are at a tipping point and Hung reminds us that our power doesn't derive from bureaucrats in Washington; it's cultivated in our communities, our homes, and around our kitchen tables."_

Friend, I get asked a lot about my time in the FBI while out on the campaign trail. And, sure, it’s fun for me to share some of the stories from “back when” that sound like something straight out of a Godfather movie. But, as I was talking to a young man in Lansing the other day, and reminiscing about my time as an FBI agent — something struck me. When I look at the FBI under Christopher Wray and Joe Biden, I hardly recognize it. They are FAR weaker on crime than when I served as a Special Agent. Call me crazy, but I don’t believe that in the United States of America we should consider it normal to have illegal immigrants beating police officers in the streets, Venezuelan gangs moving into our towns, or mothers being carjacked at stop lights. Yet the FBI seems to turn a blind eye to ALL of this. And as a result, things in most of America today look pretty similar to Chicago in the early 90s. I’m talking about the trafficking of teenage girls across state lines, drugs being sold to our young people on the streets, and a wave of violent crime victimizing members of the community. Talking about how scary things were “back when” isn’t all that different from right now. [**And that is why I am running for the United States Senate.** ](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=5d643217d7ea4503bc2348a656baf7d5&_e=BCOeTGQDJJ9IauU-c0h_iyZ-uBP6254S27uB2y0ARt33onCydMH_km-SdWBxx4hrnaQPfXmt4AepwYa38PJb68qkRvC6GU4YCyvUpwmem-oKeiyH7nvWlkYgKUf86A4SZiEJHuGrHAFPW-D_mWkSnE-n4IdYsfWlh6P6KS2DCSj2U5PhWVeDWdaIwv1TChsTdCUleYi26oRBkSWs_IlXj32tgfTNpCcQEyoX-jJe7JvJoQe6AB9JEQzQWcOw7nQTdYHpohgCn6h_VLY-cehaTgByZ6aJ7SkbgWnnflCwxCbYSH6TyLsQ8MHMRdDcIPOFjYg3sEDNsqjxuImcizURKHpOMSXuQpYSwzJUzhF7KKQ5ji90dpgrEXYenXZNvx0r1Ixyr9TekF0FtejNdkNWDPES5Gs8CjvLiyJZcPY-SHX2SoWsxLlzU3mEJr8iSF2-) Because I have seen firsthand what weak-on-crime policies can do to a community. And right now, under Joe Biden and Chuck Schumer’s leadership, we are all seeing it.

I had a mobster tell me once that he didn’t like the FBI — but he respected it. Friend, I get asked a lot about my time in the FBI while out on the campaign trail. And, sure, it’s fun for me to share some of the stories from “back when” that sound like something straight out of a Godfather movie. But, as I was talking to a young man in Lansing the other day, and reminiscing about my time as an FBI agent — something struck me. When I look at the FBI under Christopher Wray and Joe Biden, I hardly recognize it. They are FAR weaker on crime than when I served as a Special Agent. Call me crazy, but I don’t believe that in the United States of America we should consider it normal to have illegal immigrants beating police officers in the streets, Venezuelan gangs moving into our towns, or mothers being carjacked at stop lights. Yet the FBI seems to turn a blind eye to ALL of this. And as a result, things in most of America today look pretty similar to Chicago in the early 90s. I’m talking about the trafficking of teenage girls across state lines, drugs being sold to our young people on the streets, and a wave of violent crime victimizing members of the community. Talking about how scary things were “back when” isn’t all that different from right now. - Because I have seen firsthand what weak-on-crime policies can do to a community. And right now, under Joe Biden and Chuck Schumer’s leadership, we are all seeing it. I had a mobster tell me once that he didn’t like the FBI — but he respected it. Something I learned on my grandfather’s farm growing up is that when you plant seeds in good soil, you get a _much_ better yield in return. Sure, I don’t do as much farming these days, but the lesson — the value of starting on a good, strong foundation in everything I do — has stuck with me over the years.
It’s why I’m raising my son Pierce right here in Michigan, in a community of folks who are kind, hardworking, and willing to fight for their future.
It’s why I launched a grassroots Senate campaign built of, by, and for working Michiganders — one that doesn’t take a _dime_ from corporate PACs.
It’s why I turned down $20 million from one of AIPAC’s biggest donors, because I know that we can’t fix our broken system if we keep letting the wealthy buy their way to the top.
**And Peter, it’s why I’m hoping you’ll help propel our people-powered movement to victory with a donation today.**

Sure, I don’t do as much farming these days, but the lesson — the value of starting on a good, strong foundation in everything I do — has stuck with me over the years. It’s why I’m raising my son Pierce right here in Michigan, in a community of folks who are kind, hardworking, and willing to fight for their future. It’s why I launched a grassroots Senate campaign built of, by, and for working Michiganders — one that doesn’t take a dime from corporate PACs. It’s why I turned down $20 million from one of AIPAC’s biggest donors, because I know that we can’t fix our broken system if we keep letting the wealthy buy their way to the top. And Peter, it’s why I’m hoping you’ll help propel our people-powered movement to victory with a donation today. By chipping in to our grassroots campaign, you’re planting the seeds of a whole new type of leadership in Washington. I’m not a career politician looking for a fancy new title; I’m a single dad, union organizer, and small business owner running to be a voice for working families and the communities in Michigan that are too often ignored. With my campaign’s end-of-month fundraising deadline coming up, it would mean the world to receive your support. Thanks so much for chipping in. Together, we’ll plant the seeds of a future we can all be proud of. Hill Harper Democrat for U.S. Senate

| | **For Immediate Release:** February 23, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Joanna Weiss Refuses to Disavow Racist Campaign Attacks... Again** _“This isn’t the first attempt by Weiss’ campaign to characterize Min using harmful anti-Asian stereotypes... [it] makes us question her ability to properly represent AAPI community members, who account for 24% of the district’s population.” _ _\- Letter from Orange County AAPI Leaders _ **IRVINE, CA** — Despite mounting [pressure](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=97133db443&e=7017cc100e) and calls for accountability from [local](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=86fd5e8a35&e=7017cc100e) and [national](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=eeeee4edf7&e=7017cc100e) Asian American leaders, Joanna Weiss refuses to denounce racist campaign mailers sent on her behalf by a GOP-funded Super Pac. The recent mailer, funded by a dark money Super PAC supporting Joanna Weiss, has been widely criticized for its racist overtones and overt references to longstanding stereotypes that Asian Americans are untrustworthy and perpetual foreigners here in the United States. Featuring a yellow tint over Min's photo and unfounded allegations of untrustworthiness, the mailer perpetuates harmful stereotypes and fuels a dangerous climate at a time of rising hate crimes against the [API community](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=0e67ba01ba&e=7017cc100e).

CA-47 has the 9th largest API citizen aged voting populations out of 435 Congressional Districts.

Weiss's refusal to distance herself from these despicable tactics raises serious doubts about her fitness to represent CA-47 – home to one of the largest Asian American communities in the nation. Weiss has refused to engage with API language media who have covered the controversy. [A recent article from Korea Times](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=9880a0f6c8&e=7017cc100e) highlights this concerning trend, shedding light on Weiss's failure to engage with API readers on her positions.

**“Using yellow-tinted photos and depicting him in a money suit is not just racist, it's an insult to our community,”** said Congressmember Grace Meng, Chair of the Asian and Pacific Islander Congressional Caucus’ Political Action Committee ASPIRE PAC. **“These tactics will backfire with the 20% AAPI voters who live in his district. We stand against such bigotry and call for accountability." **

This is the second time that the Weiss campaign has been called out by Asian American leaders for running a racist campaign. Earlier this year, in a staggering display of disregard for the community she claims to represent, Weiss failed to address the concerns raised by local Asian Pacific Islander (API) leaders, including Susan Lew, President of the Asian Americans in Action Network; and Mary Anne Foo, founder and executive director of Orange County Asian Pacific Islander Community Alliance, who called out Weiss for levying racist attacks against Dave Min. [**In a letter published**](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=7213693241&e=7017cc100e) on January 29, 2024, leaders in the AAPI community in Orange County expressed frustration over Weiss' campaign tactics, **“This isn’t the first attempt by Weiss’ campaign to characterize Min using harmful anti-Asian stereotypes like questioning his trustworthiness, which makes us question her ability to properly represent AAPI community members, who account for 24% of the district’s population.” **

Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, as well as the California Democratic Party, Service Employees International Union (SEIU), the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, California Environmental Voters, and over 150 local, state, and federal officials. Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions, and he is the only candidate endorsed in this race by the California Labor Federation or the AFL-CIO. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c38ae39dad&e=7017cc100e).
###

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions, and he is the only candidate endorsed in this race by the California Labor Federation or the AFL-CIO. A full endorsement list is available . California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. | SB 603 Priority Treatment Jailed Pregnant and Women Passes the House Committee on Studies
---
|

| My bill SB 603 will give incarcerated pregnant women preferential treatment for drug rehab programs. I have visited the women's jail in Goochland County and I've heard reports around the district about the challenges faced by pregnant women in jail to attend drug rehab programs. Incarcerated pregnant women (those held in federal or state prisons, jails, or juvenile detention facilities) make up one of the most vulnerable segments of society, with higher rates of mental illness, drug addiction, and histories of trauma than incarcerated men. This bill will create a work group to find answers on how to help rehabilitate young and not so young women with the triple threat of being incarcerated, being pregnant, and being addicted.

clean_body: | | | | | | == | == | | I'm Running for Congress to "Save America" Christian Conservative | Trump Store Grand Opening Farmville, VA | | | | | | | | | | Bob Good lost my support when he attacked Trump and disrespected constituents in VA 05. I am answering the call from folks all across the district. We can do better than Good! We were invited to attend the 5th District Trump Store Grand Opening last Saturday in Farmville, VA. They set us up with a table to get signatures for my petition to run for Congress! My opponent was told not to show up by the owner, but he showed up anyway and had a really bad week. He foolishly posted a video showing his disrespectful behavior and it went viral. == == | 2024 Session Update Week 7 | | The General Assembly convened on January 10th. I am working hard with Governor Glenn Youngkin, Lieutenant Governor Winsome Sears, and fellow legislators to make Virginia the best place to live, work, and raise a family. There are so many threats to Virginia: skyrocketing costs, the mess in our schools, the fentanyl streaming across the border. Will the Democrats help us solve these problems? We have 15 days left in session. Then I will be able to devote my attention to my campaign for Congress. We can do better than Good. Here is some of what is on my mind and what we have been up to: | 2ND Amendment "Shall Not Be Infringed" | | | | ---|--- | I continue to speak up for and defend Virginia citizens' gun rights on the Senate floor. This family heard me defending our second amendment on the senate floor, thanked me, and asked for a photo. == == | SB 222 Cyber Security Passes the House Appropriations | | My bill SB 222 on cyber security is making its way through the house. With cyber security threats on the rise, it is imperative we take action to secure our Commonwealth's infrastructure. | == Dispatchers/ First Responders Passes the House Public Safety Committee | == | My bill SB 630 to add law enforcement Dispatchers, including State Police Dispatchers, to the category of First Responders is making its way through the House. == | SB 603 Priority Treatment Jailed Pregnant and Women Passes the House Committee on Studies | | My bill SB 603 will give incarcerated pregnant women preferential treatment for drug rehab programs. I have visited the women's jail in Goochland County and I've heard reports around the district about the challenges faced by pregnant women in jail to attend drug rehab programs. Incarcerated pregnant women (those held in federal or state prisons, jails, or juvenile detention facilities) make up one of the most vulnerable segments of society, with higher rates of mental illness, drug addiction, and histories of trauma than incarcerated men. This bill will create a work group to find answers on how to help rehabilitate young and not so young women with the triple threat of being incarcerated, being pregnant, and being addicted. | Hunting Dog Permit Language Removed from Budget | | Virginia Pro Life Day | | | | | | | | | | | | Pro-life advocates, including constituents from my district, visited my office on Wednesday morning to pray and discuss our efforts to protect our most vulnerable. I, along with fellow legislators, visited the rally at the Bell Tower before heading to caucus. Speakers at the rally included Victoria Cobb, President of the Family Foundation and Lieutenant Governor Winsome Earl-Sears. Governor Youngkin walked in front of the March for Life. In session, I had the honor of introducing these advocates and their important mission on the Senate floor. Life is a miracle and must be protected! | Hanover Patriots, GOP Chair Candidate Ryan Martin | | | | | | | | After session Thursday, I attended the Hanover GOP Candidate Forum hosted by my friends at the Hanover Patriots. Friend,

For the second time this week, far-left agitators have come to my house early in the morning chanting hateful slogans, ringing bells, and shouting at the top of their lungs.

Please know that I’ll never bow to these disgraceful tactics. I’ll stand strong for Texas and the United States of America- always. When I look outside my window at the screaming mob, I only grow more resolved and committed to fight for what’s right. Thank you.

For Liberty,
